guide.summary: 的, 得 and 地 all sound like de, so you choose by position, not by sound. Look at what comes right after the gap: a noun takes 的 (describing a thing), a verb takes 地 (how the action is carried out), and when the gap follows a verb or adjective and what comes next comments on it (how well, to what extent, whether it can be done) you need 得.

subs.label: 的: describing word + noun
subs.focus: Adjective, noun or pronoun + 的 + noun (漂亮的衣服, 我的手机). The word after the gap is clearly a noun, so only 的 fits. Classic mistake: 地 or 得 after 很 + adjective, or after a word like 认真 often seen with 地. Do not test dropping 的 (我妈妈, 好人).

subs.label: 的: clause + noun
subs.focus: Verb phrase or clause + 的 + noun: 我昨天买的书, 妈妈做的菜, 穿红衣服的人. The gap follows a verb, which tempts 得; the noun after the gap decides for 的. Classic mistake: 我买得书. The next word must be an unmistakable noun (书, 菜, 人, 地方).

subs.label: 得: verb + how well
subs.focus: Verb (no object) + 得 + 很/不/太 + adjective judging how the action is done: 跑得很快, 说得对, 睡得不好. Learner sees a verb before the gap and a judgement after it. Classic mistakes: 跑的很快; negative before the verb (不跑得快) instead of after 得 (跑得不快).

subs.label: 得: so ... that ...
subs.focus: Adjective/verb + 得 + result clause: 累得不想说话, 忙得没时间吃饭, 笑得肚子都疼了. Classic mistake: 累地 or 累的. Use state words that cannot be the manner of the next action (累, 忙, 热, 冷, 饿, 困) or a clause with its own subject. Avoid 高兴___跳了起来: 得 and 地 both work.

subs.label: 得 after verb + object
subs.focus: 得 attaches to the verb, never the object. With an object, repeat the verb (说汉语说得很好) or front the object (汉语说得很好); includes 唱歌唱得, 游泳游得, 睡觉睡得. Classic mistake: 他说汉语得很好, 她唱歌得很好听. Suits order and judge items, and cloze with the gap as verb + 得.

subs.label: 得: can do (听得懂)
subs.focus: Verb + 得 + result/direction word = can: 听得懂, 看得见, 吃得完, 买得到. Negative swaps 得 for 不 (听不懂). Learner picks 得 from the frame verb + gap + 懂/见/完/到, and 得 versus 不 from the meaning. Classic mistakes: 听的懂, 我不听得懂, 听得不懂.

subs.label: 地: how + verb
subs.focus: Two-syllable adjective or phrase + 地 + verb, the manner of an action: 高兴地说, 认真地听, 生气地走了. The word after the gap is a verb and the word before is not the main verb. Classic mistake: 高兴的说 (common informally; 地 is standard) or 高兴得说. Avoid words that take no particle (快走, 多吃, 已经).

subs.label: Doubled adjective + 地
subs.focus: Doubled adjective before a verb: 慢慢地走, 轻轻地关上门, 高高兴兴地回家. Doubling must not decide: the same word takes 的 before a noun (大大的眼睛) and follows 得 as a complement (打扫得干干净净). Mix the three positions. Never offer ∅: 慢慢走 is also correct.

subs.label: Same word, three positions
subs.focus: One adjective (认真, 快, 清楚, 仔细, 流利, 努力) in a frame that fixes its role: 认真的学生, 认真地学习, 学得很认真. Learner reads the neighbours of the gap, not the adjective. Classic mistake: turning English -ly into 地 where Chinese wants 得 for a judgement (他很好地唱歌 for 'he sings well').

rules.rule: If the next word is a noun (a thing, person, place or idea) and the gap links a description or an owner to it, write 的.

examples.zh: 她买了一件很漂亮的衣服。
examples.py: tā mǎi le yī jiàn hěn piào liang de yī fu
examples.en: She bought a very pretty piece of clothing.

examples.py: zhè shì wǒ de shǒu jī
examples.en: This is my phone.

examples.zh: 这是一个非常重要的问题。
examples.py: zhè shì yī gè fēi cháng zhòng yào de wèn tí
examples.en: This is a very important question.

rules.note: The noun can be left out when it is obvious (这本书是我的 'this book is mine'); it is still 的. 的 is often dropped with close relations (我妈妈) and one-syllable adjectives (好人, 新车), but whenever a de is written before a noun, it is 的.

rules.rule: A whole clause can describe a noun. It goes in front of the noun and is joined to it with 的, even though the word just before 的 is a verb.

examples.zh: 我昨天买的书很有意思。
examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de shū hěn yǒu yì si
examples.en: The book I bought yesterday is very interesting.

examples.py: zhè shì mā ma zuò de cài
examples.en: This is the food Mum made.

examples.zh: 穿红衣服的那个人是我姐姐。
examples.py: chuān hóng yī fu de nà ge rén shì wǒ jiě jie
examples.en: The person wearing red is my older sister.

rules.note: Verb + de + noun is 的 (买的书 'the book that was bought'); verb + de + adjective is 得 (买得很多 'bought a lot'). Look at what follows.

rules.rule: To say how well, how fast or how badly something is done, put 得 straight after the verb and the judgement after 得.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 得 + 很 / 不 / 太 / 非常 + Adjective

examples.py: tā pǎo de hěn kuài
examples.en: He runs fast.

examples.py: nǐ shuō de duì
examples.en: You're right. (You said it correctly.)

examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang shuì de bù hǎo
examples.en: I didn't sleep well last night.

examples.py: tā jīn tiān lái de hěn zǎo
examples.en: She came very early today.

rules.note: The negative and the question go after 得, not before the verb: 睡得不好, 睡得好不好, 睡得怎么样. No 了 is added after the verb, even for a past event.

rules.rule: To say 'so tired / busy / hot that ...', put 得 after the adjective or verb and then say what happens as a result.
rules.pattern: Subject + Adjective / Verb + 得 + result clause

examples.py: wǒ lèi de bù xiǎng shuō huà
examples.en: I'm so tired I don't want to talk.

examples.zh: 他最近忙得没有时间吃饭。
examples.py: tā zuì jìn máng de méi yǒu shí jiān chī fàn
examples.en: He's been so busy lately that he has no time to eat.

examples.zh: 孩子们笑得肚子都疼了。
examples.py: hái zi men xiào de dù zi dōu téng le
examples.en: The children laughed so hard their stomachs hurt.

rules.note: With feeling words such as 高兴 or 生气, both readings can exist: 她高兴得跳了起来 (so happy that she jumped up) and 她高兴地跳了起来 (she jumped up happily) are both correct, with different emphasis. With 累, 忙, 热, 冷, 饿, 困 only 得 works.

rules.rule: 得 cannot come after an object. If the verb has an object, say the verb again before 得, or move the object in front of the verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + Object + Verb + 得 + Adjective

examples.py: tā shuō hàn yǔ shuō de hěn hǎo
examples.en: He speaks Chinese very well.

examples.py: tā hàn yǔ shuō de hěn hǎo
examples.en: He speaks Chinese very well.

examples.py: tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo tīng
examples.en: She sings beautifully.

examples.py: wǒ dì di yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài
examples.en: My younger brother swims fast.

rules.note: Words like 唱歌, 游泳, 跳舞, 睡觉, 跑步 are verb + object inside, so only the first character is repeated: 游泳游得, not 游泳得. The object can also be made the topic: 汉语他说得很好.

rules.rule: Verb + 得 + result word means 'can manage to'. For 'cannot', swap 得 for 不; do not add 不 anywhere else.
rules.pattern: Verb + 得 / 不 + result or direction word (+ Object)

examples.zh: 老师说的话我都听得懂。
examples.py: lǎo shī shuō de huà wǒ dōu tīng de dǒng
examples.en: I can understand everything the teacher says.

examples.zh: 你看得见黑板上的字吗？
examples.py: nǐ kàn de jiàn hēi bǎn shàng de zì ma
examples.en: Can you see the characters on the blackboard?

examples.py: cài tài duō le wǒ men chī bù wán
examples.en: There's too much food; we can't finish it.

rules.note: Tell the two 得 apart by what follows: 听得懂 (verb + 得 + result word, 'can understand') versus 听得很清楚 (verb + 得 + 很 + adjective, 'heard it very clearly'). Their negatives differ: 听不懂 but 听得不清楚.

rules.rule: When a describing word comes before a verb and tells you the manner of that action, join them with 地.
rules.pattern: Subject + Adjective / descriptive phrase + 地 + Verb

examples.py: hái zi men gāo xìng de huí jiā le
examples.en: The children happily went home.

examples.py: tā rèn zhēn de tīng lǎo shī jiǎng kè
examples.en: She listens carefully to the teacher's lesson.

examples.py: tā shēng qì de zǒu le
examples.en: He walked off angrily.

rules.note: 地 is read de here (dì only in words like 地方, 地铁). Many adverbs take no particle at all (很, 都, 已经, 常常, 快走, 多吃), and some two-syllable adjectives can drop 地 (认真学习). In everyday writing people often put 的 in this position, but 地 is the standard form.

rules.rule: A doubled adjective in front of a verb takes 地. The doubling does not choose the character; the position does.

examples.py: nǐ màn màn de shuō bié zháo jí
examples.en: Say it slowly, don't worry.

examples.py: tā qīng qīng de guān shàng le mén
examples.en: He gently closed the door.

examples.zh: 她高高兴兴地去上学了。
examples.py: tā gāo gāo xìng xìng de qù shàng xué le
examples.en: She went off to school in high spirits.

examples.py: fáng jiān dǎ sǎo de gān gān jìng jìng
examples.en: The room has been cleaned spotless.

rules.note: 地 after a doubled adjective is optional (慢慢说 is also fine), so the choice tested is which de, never whether to use one. Before a noun the same doubled word takes 的: 他有一双大大的眼睛.

rules.rule: The same adjective takes a different de in each position: before a noun 的, before a verb 地, after verb + 得 as a judgement.
rules.pattern: Adjective + 的 + Noun / Adjective + 地 + Verb / Verb + 得 + 很 + Adjective

examples.zh: 他是一个很认真的学生。
examples.py: tā shì yī gè hěn rèn zhēn de xué sheng
examples.en: He is a very conscientious student.

examples.zh: 他每天都认真地做作业。
examples.py: tā měi tiān dōu rèn zhēn de zuò zuò yè
examples.en: He does his homework carefully every day.

examples.py: tā xué de hěn rèn zhēn
examples.en: He studies very conscientiously.

rules.rule: English 'does it well / fast / badly' is a judgement of the action, so Chinese puts it after the verb with 得. Use 地 before the verb only to describe the manner in which one particular action is carried out.
rules.pattern: Verb + 得 + 很 + Adjective (judgement) / Adjective + 地 + Verb (manner)

examples.py: tā de zì xiě de hěn piào liang
examples.en: She writes characters beautifully.

examples.py: tā hěn kuài de chī wán le zǎo fàn
examples.en: He quickly finished his breakfast.

examples.py: tā chī fàn chī de hěn kuài
examples.en: He eats fast.

rules.note: 好 meaning 'well' almost never goes before the verb with 地: say 唱得很好, not 很好地唱. Where both orders are possible (很快地跑 / 跑得很快), the meaning shifts slightly, but the character is still fixed by the position.

contrasts.why: 很快 judges the running and comes after the verb, so the link is 得. 的 would need a noun after it.

right.py: zhè shì wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de shū
right.en: This is the book I bought yesterday.

contrasts.why: The gap follows a verb, but what comes next is the noun 书. A clause describing a noun is joined with 的.

right.py: hái zi men gāo xìng de huí jiā le

contrasts.why: 高兴 describes the manner of 回家, a verb, so the standard character is 地. 的 only links to a noun.

right.py: tā shuō hàn yǔ shuō de hěn hǎo

contrasts.why: 得 must follow the verb directly, not the object 汉语. Repeat the verb, or say 他汉语说得很好.

right.py: tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo

contrasts.why: English 'well' is a judgement of her singing, which Chinese puts after the verb with 得, not before it with 地.

right.py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì de bù hǎo

contrasts.why: With 得 + judgement, the negative goes on the judgement (不好), not in front of the verb.

right.py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng tā shuō de huà
right.en: I can't understand what he says.

contrasts.why: The 'cannot' form of 听得懂 replaces 得 with 不: 听不懂. 不 is never placed before the verb here.

right.py: wǒ lèi de bù xiǎng chī fàn
right.en: I'm so tired I don't want to eat.

contrasts.why: 不想吃饭 is the result of being tired, not an action done in a tired manner. 'So ... that ...' is adjective + 得 + result.

contrasts.wrong: 他是一个很认真地学生。

right.zh: 他是一个很认真的学生。
right.py: tā shì yī gè hěn rèn zhēn de xué sheng
right.en: He is a very conscientious student.

contrasts.why: 认真 is often seen with 地, but here the next word is the noun 学生, so it must be 的.

cheat: Look right first: noun next means 的, verb next means 地.
Verb or adjective on the left and a judgement, result or 'can do' word on the right means 得.
Verb + de + noun is 的 (买的书); verb + de + 很 + adjective is 得 (买得很多).
得 sticks to the verb: with an object, repeat the verb (说汉语说得很好).
Negatives: 跑得不快 for 'not fast', 听不懂 for 'cannot'; never 不 in front of the verb.
So tired / busy / hot that ...: 累得, 忙得, 热得.
Doubled adjectives do not decide: 慢慢地走, 大大的眼睛, 打扫得干干净净.

items.q: 这是我___书包。
items.zh: 这是我的书包。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ de shū bāo
items.en: This is my school bag.
items.why: 我 is the owner and 书包 is a noun, so 的 links them. 得 follows a verb or adjective and 地 sits before a verb; neither can join a possessor to a noun.

items.q: 老师有一本很大___词典。
items.zh: 老师有一本很大的词典。
items.py: lǎo shī yǒu yī běn hěn dà de cí diǎn
items.en: The teacher has a very big dictionary.
items.why: 很大 describes the noun 词典 that comes next, so the link is 的. 地 would need a verb after it.

items.q: 她是一个很好___学生。
items.zh: 她是一个很好的学生。
items.py: tā shì yī gè hěn hǎo de xué sheng
items.en: She is a very good student.
items.why: 好 describes the noun 学生, so 的. 得 would need a verb before it, and 地 a verb after it.

items.q: 办公室里有一台很旧___打印机。
items.zh: 办公室里有一台很旧的打印机。
items.py: bàn gōng shì lǐ yǒu yī tái hěn jiù de dǎ yìn jī
items.en: There is a very old printer in the office.
items.why: The word after the gap is the noun 打印机 and 很旧 describes it, so 的. 地 only goes in front of a verb.

items.q: 经理给了我一份很重要___文件。
items.zh: 经理给了我一份很重要的文件。
items.py: jīng lǐ gěi le wǒ yī fèn hěn zhòng yào de wén jiàn
items.en: The manager gave me a very important document.
items.why: 很重要 modifies the noun 文件. Adjective + noun is joined with 的; 地 and 得 both need a verb beside them.

items.q: 我们公司需要一位经验丰富___工程师。
items.zh: 我们公司需要一位经验丰富的工程师。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī xū yào yī wèi jīng yàn fēng fù de gōng chéng shī
items.en: Our company needs an experienced engineer.
items.why: 经验丰富 is a descriptive phrase and 工程师 is the noun it describes, so 的. Even a longer phrase before a noun takes 的, never 地.

items.q: 这是我昨天写___信。
items.zh: 这是我昨天写的信。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ zuó tiān xiě de xìn
items.en: This is the letter I wrote yesterday.
items.why: The gap follows the verb 写, but what comes next is the noun 信, so the clause 我昨天写 describes it with 的. 得 would need a judgement like 很快 after it.

items.q: 老师讲___课很有意思。
items.zh: 老师讲的课很有意思。
items.py: lǎo shī jiǎng de kè hěn yǒu yì si
items.en: The lesson the teacher gave is very interesting.
items.why: 老师讲 is a clause describing the noun 课, so 的. 得 would be followed by a judgement of how well the teacher explained, not by a noun.

items.q: 这是老师给我___作业。
items.zh: 这是老师给我的作业。
items.py: zhè shì lǎo shī gěi wǒ de zuò yè
items.en: This is the homework the teacher gave me.
items.why: 老师给我 describes 作业, the noun after the gap, so 的. The verb before the gap does not make it 得 when a noun follows.

items.q: 坐在前面___那个同学是我朋友。
items.zh: 坐在前面的那个同学是我朋友。
items.py: zuò zài qián miàn de nà ge tóng xué shì wǒ péng you
items.en: The classmate sitting in front is my friend.
items.why: 坐在前面 is a verb phrase that describes 那个同学, so it takes 的. 得 would need a complement after it, not a noun.

items.q: 我在网上买___那本字典今天到了。
items.zh: 我在网上买的那本字典今天到了。
items.py: wǒ zài wǎng shàng mǎi de nà běn zì diǎn jīn tiān dào le
items.en: The dictionary I bought online arrived today.
items.why: 我在网上买 describes the dictionary, so 的 attaches the clause to 那本字典. 买得 would have to be followed by something like 很多.

items.q: 经理昨天开会说___话，我没听清楚。
items.zh: 经理昨天开会说的话，我没听清楚。
items.py: jīng lǐ zuó tiān kāi huì shuō de huà wǒ méi tīng qīng chu
items.en: I didn't catch clearly what the manager said at the meeting yesterday.
items.why: 说 + 的 + 话 means 'the words that were said'; the noun 话 after the gap decides for 的. 说得 would be followed by a judgement such as 很快.

items.q: 他上个星期交给经理___报告，经理还没看完。
items.zh: 他上个星期交给经理的报告，经理还没看完。
items.py: tā shàng gè xīng qī jiāo gěi jīng lǐ de bào gào jīng lǐ hái méi kàn wán
items.en: The report he handed to the manager last week: the manager hasn't finished reading it yet.
items.why: 交给经理 is a verb phrase that describes 报告, so the clause takes 的. 得 and 地 cannot link a verb phrase to a following noun.

items.q: 在会议上提出这个建议___人是小王。
items.zh: 在会议上提出这个建议的人是小王。
items.py: zài huì yì shàng tí chū zhè ge jiàn yì de rén shì xiǎo wáng
items.en: The person who made this suggestion at the meeting was Xiao Wang.
items.why: The whole clause 在会议上提出这个建议 describes the noun 人, so 的. The long clause does not change the rule: noun next means 的.

items.q: 小王跑___很快。
items.zh: 小王跑得很快。
items.py: xiǎo wáng pǎo de hěn kuài
items.en: Xiao Wang runs fast.
items.why: 很快 judges how he runs and follows the verb 跑 directly, so 得. 的 needs a noun after it and 地 a verb.

items.q: 他今天来___很早。
items.zh: 他今天来得很早。
items.py: tā jīn tiān lái de hěn zǎo
items.en: He came very early today.
items.why: 来 + 得 + 很早 judges how early he came, so 得. No 了 is added after 来 here, and no noun follows the gap for 的.

items.q: 弟弟昨天睡___太晚了。
items.zh: 弟弟昨天睡得太晚了。
items.py: dì di zuó tiān shuì de tài wǎn le
items.en: My younger brother went to bed too late yesterday.
items.why: 太晚 is a judgement on how he slept, placed after the verb 睡, so 得. 地 would need a verb directly after the gap.

items.q: 昨天晚上我睡___不太好。
items.zh: 昨天晚上我睡得不太好。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ shuì de bù tài hǎo
items.en: I didn't sleep very well last night.
items.why: The negative judgement 不太好 comes after the verb 睡 and is linked with 得. 的 would need a noun and 地 a following verb.

items.q: 这次考试小李考___特别好。
items.zh: 这次考试小李考得特别好。
items.py: zhè cì kǎo shì xiǎo lǐ kǎo de tè bié hǎo
items.en: Xiao Li did especially well in this exam.
items.why: 特别好 grades how he took the exam, so it follows 考 with 得. 的 would need a noun after it, and 地 a verb.

items.q: 同学们都来___很准时。
items.zh: 同学们都来得很准时。
items.py: tóng xué men dōu lái de hěn zhǔn shí
items.en: The students all arrived very punctually.
items.why: 很准时 comments on how they came and sits right after the verb 来, so 得. No noun or verb follows the gap that could call for 的 or 地.

items.q: 老板今天笑___特别开心。
items.zh: 老板今天笑得特别开心。
items.py: lǎo bǎn jīn tiān xiào de tè bié kāi xīn
items.en: The boss laughed very happily today.
items.why: 特别开心 describes the way he laughed and follows the verb 笑, so 得. 地 goes before a verb, not after one.

items.q: 这个学期的课安排___太紧了，学生们没有时间休息。
items.zh: 这个学期的课安排得太紧了，学生们没有时间休息。
items.py: zhè ge xué qī de kè ān pái de tài jǐn le xué sheng men méi yǒu shí jiān xiū xi
items.en: The classes this term are scheduled too tightly; the students have no time to rest.
items.why: 太紧了 judges how the classes are scheduled and follows the verb 安排, so 得. A noun would have to follow the gap for 的.

items.q: 他昨天加班加到很晚，所以今天起___特别晚。
items.zh: 他昨天加班加到很晚，所以今天起得特别晚。
items.py: tā zuó tiān jiā bān jiā dào hěn wǎn suǒ yǐ jīn tiān qǐ de tè bié wǎn
items.en: He worked overtime very late yesterday, so he got up especially late today.
items.why: 特别晚 is a judgement on when he got up, attached to the verb 起 with 得. 的 and 地 both need a noun or verb after the gap.

items.q: 我累___不想说话。
items.zh: 我累得不想说话。
items.py: wǒ lèi de bù xiǎng shuō huà
items.en: I'm so tired I don't want to talk.
items.why: 累 is a state and 不想说话 is its result, so adjective + 得 + result. 地 would make 累 the manner of talking, which makes no sense.

items.q: 今天热___我不想出门。
items.zh: 今天热得我不想出门。
items.py: jīn tiān rè de wǒ bù xiǎng chū mén
items.en: It's so hot today that I don't want to go out.
items.why: 热 is a weather state and 我不想出门 is the consequence, so 得. 热 cannot describe the manner of an action, so 地 fails.

items.q: 他最近忙___没有时间吃饭。
items.zh: 他最近忙得没有时间吃饭。
items.py: tā zuì jìn máng de méi yǒu shí jiān chī fàn
items.en: He has been so busy lately that he has no time to eat.
items.why: 忙 + 得 + clause means 'so busy that ...'. 没有时间吃饭 is the result, not a manner of doing something, so 地 is wrong.

items.q: 教室里冷___大家都穿上了外套。
items.zh: 教室里冷得大家都穿上了外套。
items.py: jiào shì lǐ lěng de dà jiā dōu chuān shàng le wài tào
items.en: It was so cold in the classroom that everyone put on their coats.
items.why: 冷 + 得 + a new clause with its own subject 大家 gives 'so cold that ...'. 的 would need a noun to follow, and 地 a manner.

items.q: 我饿___一口气吃了三个面包。
items.zh: 我饿得一口气吃了三个面包。
items.py: wǒ è de yī kǒu qì chī le sān gè miàn bāo
items.en: I was so hungry that I ate three rolls in one go.
items.why: 饿 is the state and eating three rolls is the result, so 得. 饿 cannot be the manner of eating the way 认真 can, so 地 is out.

items.q: 昨天加班到十二点，我困___一上床就睡着了。
items.zh: 昨天加班到十二点，我困得一上床就睡着了。
items.py: zuó tiān jiā bān dào shí èr diǎn wǒ kùn de yī shàng chuáng jiù shuì zháo le
items.en: I worked overtime until twelve yesterday and was so sleepy that I fell asleep the moment I got into bed.
items.why: 困 + 得 + result clause: falling asleep at once is the consequence of being sleepy. 地 would mean sleepily doing something, which does not fit the result clause.

items.q: 这道题复杂___全班只有两个人做对了。
items.zh: 这道题复杂得全班只有两个人做对了。
items.py: zhè dào tí fù zá de quán bān zhǐ yǒu liǎng gè rén zuò duì le
items.en: This question was so complicated that only two people in the class got it right.
items.why: 复杂 + 得 + clause with its own subject 全班 means 'so complicated that ...'. 的 would need a noun right after it, and 复杂 here is a state, not the manner of an action, so 地 fails.

items.q: 同事们笑___眼泪都流出来了。
items.zh: 同事们笑得眼泪都流出来了。
items.py: tóng shì men xiào de yǎn lèi dōu liú chū lái le
items.en: My colleagues laughed so hard that tears came out.
items.why: 笑 + 得 + result clause: tears flowing is what the laughing led to. 地 would need a verb right after it, and 眼泪都流出来了 is a result, not an action done in a laughing manner.

items.q: 他说汉语说___很好。
items.zh: 他说汉语说得很好。
items.py: tā shuō hàn yǔ shuō de hěn hǎo
items.en: He speaks Chinese very well.
items.why: With an object, the verb is repeated and 得 attaches to the second 说. 的 would need a noun after it and 地 a verb.

items.q: 她唱歌唱___很好听。
items.zh: 她唱歌唱得很好听。
items.py: tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo tīng
items.en: She sings beautifully.
items.why: 唱歌 is verb + object, so the verb 唱 is repeated and 得 follows it, then comes the judgement 很好听.

items.q: 我姐姐做饭做___不错。
items.zh: 我姐姐做饭做得不错。
items.py: wǒ jiě jie zuò fàn zuò de bù cuò
items.en: My older sister cooks quite well.
items.why: The object 饭 is already said, so 做 is repeated and 得 follows it. The judgement 不错 comes after 得.

items.q: 我同事写报告写___很快。
items.zh: 我同事写报告写得很快。
items.py: wǒ tóng shì xiě bào gào xiě de hěn kuài
items.en: My colleague writes reports very fast.
items.why: 写报告 has an object, so 写 comes again before 得: 写报告写得很快. 地 would belong before a verb.

items.q: 小王打字打___特别快。
items.zh: 小王打字打得特别快。
items.py: xiǎo wáng dǎ zì dǎ de tè bié kuài
items.en: Xiao Wang types especially fast.
items.why: 打字 is verb + object, so only 打 is repeated before 得. 打字得 would put 得 after the object, which is wrong.

items.q: 我弟弟游泳游___比我好。
items.zh: 我弟弟游泳游得比我好。
items.py: wǒ dì di yóu yǒng yóu de bǐ wǒ hǎo
items.en: My younger brother swims better than I do.
items.why: 游泳 is verb + object inside, so 游 is repeated before 得. The comparison 比我好 is the judgement after 得.

items.q: 李老师讲课讲___生动有趣，学生们都喜欢听。
items.zh: 李老师讲课讲得生动有趣，学生们都喜欢听。
items.py: lǐ lǎo shī jiǎng kè jiǎng de shēng dòng yǒu qù xué sheng men dōu xǐ huan tīng
items.en: Teacher Li's lessons are lively and interesting; the students all love listening.
items.why: 讲课 has an object, so 讲 is repeated and 得 follows it before the judgement 生动有趣. 的 would need a noun after it.

items.q: 老师说得很慢，所以我全部听___懂。
items.zh: 老师说得很慢，所以我全部听得懂。
items.py: lǎo shī shuō de hěn màn suǒ yǐ wǒ quán bù tīng de dǒng
items.en: The teacher speaks slowly, so I can understand all of it.
items.why: 所以 shows that the slow speech makes understanding possible: 听得懂 means 'can understand'. 听不懂 would contradict the reason given.

items.q: 字太小了，我看___见。
items.zh: 字太小了，我看不见。
items.py: zì tài xiǎo le wǒ kàn bù jiàn
items.en: The characters are too small; I can't see them.
items.why: 太小了 gives the reason for 'cannot': swap 得 for 不 to get 看不见. 看得见 would say the opposite of what the context implies.

items.q: 菜太多了，我们三个人吃___完。
items.zh: 菜太多了，我们三个人吃不完。
items.py: cài tài duō le wǒ men sān gè rén chī bù wán
items.en: There's too much food; the three of us can't finish it.
items.why: 太多了 means the food is more than they can eat, so the negative potential 吃不完. 吃得完 'can finish' contradicts the context.

items.q: 这本书很便宜，学生都买___起。
items.zh: 这本书很便宜，学生都买得起。
items.py: zhè běn shū hěn pián yi xué sheng dōu mǎi de qǐ
items.en: This book is cheap; students can all afford it.
items.why: 很便宜 means it is affordable, so the positive form 买得起. 买不起 would say nobody can afford it, which contradicts 很便宜.

items.q: 题目太难了，我做___出来。
items.zh: 题目太难了，我做不出来。
items.py: tí mù tài nán le wǒ zuò bù chū lái
items.en: The question is too hard; I can't work it out.
items.why: 太难了 explains why he fails: 做不出来 'cannot work out'. 做得出来 would mean he can, which contradicts the reason.

items.q: 我坐在第一排，黑板上的字看___清楚。
items.zh: 我坐在第一排，黑板上的字看得清楚。
items.py: wǒ zuò zài dì yī pái hēi bǎn shàng de zì kàn de qīng chu
items.en: I sit in the front row, so I can see the writing on the blackboard clearly.
items.why: The front row makes seeing easy, so the positive 看得清楚. 看不清楚 would clash with sitting at the front.

items.q: 资料不多，一个晚上肯定准备___完。
items.zh: 资料不多，一个晚上肯定准备得完。
items.py: zī liào bù duō yī gè wǎn shang kěn dìng zhǔn bèi de wán
items.en: There aren't many materials, so one evening is definitely enough to get them ready.
items.why: 资料不多 and 肯定 point to 'can manage it': 准备得完. 准备不完 would mean there is too much, the reverse of the first clause.

items.q: 他说得太快，我一句也听___懂。
items.zh: 他说得太快，我一句也听不懂。
items.py: tā shuō de tài kuài wǒ yī jù yě tīng bù dǒng
items.en: He spoke too fast; I couldn't understand a single sentence.
items.why: 一句也 requires a negative, so 听不懂. 不 replaces 得 inside the verb and result word; 听得懂 would be positive and clash with 一句也.

items.q: 同学们高兴___回家了。
items.zh: 同学们高兴地回家了。
items.py: tóng xué men gāo xìng de huí jiā le
items.en: The classmates went home happily.
items.why: 高兴 describes how they went home, so it sits before the verb 回家 with 地. 得 would need to follow a verb and be followed by a result or judgement.

items.q: 她认真___听老师讲课。
items.zh: 她认真地听老师讲课。
items.py: tā rèn zhēn de tīng lǎo shī jiǎng kè
items.en: She listens carefully to the teacher's lesson.
items.why: 认真 is the manner of the verb 听 that follows, so 地. 得 only goes after a verb, and 认真 is not the main verb here.

items.q: 学生们安静___坐在教室里。
items.zh: 学生们安静地坐在教室里。
items.py: xué sheng men ān jìng de zuò zài jiào shì lǐ
items.en: The students sat quietly in the classroom.
items.why: 安静 tells how they sat and comes before the verb 坐, so 地. 得 would belong after a verb.

items.q: 小王仔细___检查了每一份文件。
items.zh: 小王仔细地检查了每一份文件。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zǐ xì de jiǎn chá le měi yī fèn wén jiàn
items.en: Xiao Wang carefully checked every document.
items.why: 仔细 is the manner of the action 检查 which follows, so 地. 得 would need a verb before the gap.

items.q: 经理耐心___回答了客户的问题。
items.zh: 经理耐心地回答了客户的问题。
items.py: jīng lǐ nài xīn de huí dá le kè hù de wèn tí
items.en: The manager patiently answered the client's questions.
items.why: 耐心 describes how the manager answered, and the verb 回答 comes right after the gap, so 地. 得 is wrong because no verb comes before it.

items.q: 为了准备考试，她每天都努力___复习到很晚。
items.zh: 为了准备考试，她每天都努力地复习到很晚。
items.py: wèi le zhǔn bèi kǎo shì tā měi tiān dōu nǔ lì de fù xí dào hěn wǎn
items.en: To prepare for the exam, she studies hard every day until late.
items.why: 努力 describes the manner of 复习, which follows the gap, so 地. 得 would need a verb before 努力 in a pattern like 学得很努力.

items.q: 开会的时候，大家都专心___听经理介绍新的计划。
items.zh: 开会的时候，大家都专心地听经理介绍新的计划。
items.py: kāi huì de shí hou dà jiā dōu zhuān xīn de tīng jīng lǐ jiè shào xīn de jì huà
items.en: During the meeting, everyone listened attentively as the manager introduced the new plan.
items.why: 专心 is how everyone listened and comes directly before the verb 听, so 地. 得 would have to follow the verb 听.

items.q: 你慢慢___说，我听得懂。
items.zh: 你慢慢地说，我听得懂。
items.py: nǐ màn màn de shuō wǒ tīng de dǒng
items.en: Say it slowly; I can understand.
items.why: 慢慢 is a doubled adjective before the verb 说, so 地. The doubling does not change the rule: before a verb it is 地, not 得.

items.q: 她有一双大大___眼睛。
items.zh: 她有一双大大的眼睛。
items.py: tā yǒu yī shuāng dà dà de yǎn jing
items.en: She has a pair of big eyes.
items.why: 大大 is a doubled adjective but it describes the noun 眼睛, so 的. Doubling does not turn it into 地.

items.q: 他轻轻___关上了办公室的门。
items.zh: 他轻轻地关上了办公室的门。
items.py: tā qīng qīng de guān shàng le bàn gōng shì de mén
items.en: He closed the office door gently.
items.why: 轻轻 is the manner of 关上 which comes next, so 地. 得 would require a verb before 轻轻.

items.q: 你把教室打扫___干干净净，老师会高兴的。
items.zh: 你把教室打扫得干干净净，老师会高兴的。
items.py: nǐ bǎ jiào shì dǎ sǎo de gān gān jìng jìng lǎo shī huì gāo xìng de
items.en: Clean the classroom spotless and the teacher will be pleased.
items.why: 干干净净 is a doubled adjective but it is the result after the verb 打扫, so 得. The doubled form does not choose 地 here.

items.q: 她高高兴兴___去公司上班了。
items.zh: 她高高兴兴地去公司上班了。
items.py: tā gāo gāo xìng xìng de qù gōng sī shàng bān le
items.en: She went to work happily.
items.why: 高高兴兴 describes how she went and comes before the verb 去, so 地. 得 needs a verb right before it, which is missing.

items.q: 小李把桌子擦___干干净净。
items.zh: 小李把桌子擦得干干净净。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ bǎ zhuō zi cā de gān gān jìng jìng
items.en: Xiao Li wiped the table spotlessly clean.
items.why: 干干净净 follows the verb 擦 and states the resulting condition, so 得. 地 goes before verbs, and no noun follows for 的.

items.q: 他把报告整整齐齐___放在经理的桌子上。
items.zh: 他把报告整整齐齐地放在经理的桌子上。
items.py: tā bǎ bào gào zhěng zhěng qí qí de fàng zài jīng lǐ de zhuō zi shàng
items.en: He placed the report neatly on the manager's desk.
items.why: 整整齐齐 is placed before the verb 放 and tells how the report was put down, so 地. 得 would only work if the doubled adjective came after 放.

items.q: 桌子上放着一杯热热___咖啡，是同事刚给我倒的。
items.zh: 桌子上放着一杯热热的咖啡，是同事刚给我倒的。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yī bēi rè rè de kā fēi shì tóng shì gāng gěi wǒ dào de
items.en: There's a cup of hot coffee on the desk that a colleague just poured for me.
items.why: 热热 describes the noun 咖啡, so 的, even though it is doubled. 得 and 地 both need a verb beside them.

items.q: 他是一个很努力___学生。
items.zh: 他是一个很努力的学生。
items.py: tā shì yī gè hěn nǔ lì de xué sheng
items.en: He is a very hardworking student.
items.why: The noun 学生 follows the gap, so 的. The same word 努力 would take 地 before a verb.

items.q: 他学___很认真。
items.zh: 他学得很认真。
items.py: tā xué de hěn rèn zhēn
items.en: He studies very conscientiously.
items.why: 很认真 judges how he studies and comes after the verb 学, so 得. The same word before a noun would be 认真的.

items.q: 她每天认真___做作业。
items.zh: 她每天认真地做作业。
items.py: tā měi tiān rèn zhēn de zuò zuò yè
items.en: She does her homework carefully every day.
items.why: 认真 comes before the verb 做 and gives its manner, so 地. After a verb it would be 得, and before a noun 的.

items.q: 小王的字写___很清楚，不用再抄一遍。
items.zh: 小王的字写得很清楚，不用再抄一遍。
items.py: xiǎo wáng de zì xiě de hěn qīng chu bù yòng zài chāo yī biàn
items.en: Xiao Wang's writing is very clear; there's no need to copy it again.
items.why: 很清楚 grades how the characters are written, and follows the verb 写, so 得. 地 would put 清楚 before the verb.

items.q: 请你清楚___告诉我你的想法。
items.zh: 请你清楚地告诉我你的想法。
items.py: qǐng nǐ qīng chu de gào sù wǒ nǐ de xiǎng fǎ
items.en: Please tell me your thoughts clearly.
items.why: 清楚 is the manner of 告诉 and stands before it, so 地. 得 would require the adjective to come after the verb.

items.q: 她的英语说___很流利。
items.zh: 她的英语说得很流利。
items.py: tā de yīng yǔ shuō de hěn liú lì
items.en: She speaks English very fluently.
items.why: The object 英语 is fronted, so 说 is directly followed by 得 and the judgement 很流利. 的 would need a noun after it.

items.q: 这是一份写得很清楚___报告，大家都看得懂。
items.zh: 这是一份写得很清楚的报告，大家都看得懂。
items.py: zhè shì yī fèn xiě de hěn qīng chu de bào gào dà jiā dōu kàn de dǒng
items.en: This is a clearly written report that everyone can understand.
items.why: 写得很清楚 is a whole phrase describing the noun 报告, so the link is 的. The earlier 得 in 写得 does not carry over to this gap.

items.q: 那位老师用流利___汉语给我们讲了一个故事。
items.zh: 那位老师用流利的汉语给我们讲了一个故事。
items.py: nà wèi lǎo shī yòng liú lì de hàn yǔ gěi wǒ men jiǎng le yī gè gù shi
items.en: That teacher told us a story in fluent Chinese.
items.why: 流利 describes the noun 汉语, so 的. The same word is 地 before a verb (流利地说) and 得 after one (说得流利).

items.q: 他把这个问题仔细___想了一遍，才回答经理。
items.zh: 他把这个问题仔细地想了一遍，才回答经理。
items.py: tā bǎ zhè ge wèn tí zǐ xì de xiǎng le yī biàn cái huí dá jīng lǐ
items.en: He thought the question over carefully before answering the manager.
items.why: 仔细 comes before the verb 想 and gives its manner, so 地. 得 would need 仔细 to follow a verb.

items.zh: 我哥哥开车开得很慢。
items.py: wǒ gē ge kāi chē kāi de hěn màn
items.en: My older brother drives slowly.
items.why: With an object 车, the verb 开 is repeated and 得 is attached to the second one. The judgement 很慢 comes last.

items.zh: 小李昨天走得很晚。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ zuó tiān zǒu de hěn wǎn
items.en: Xiao Li left very late yesterday.
items.why: 得 stays attached to the verb and the judgement follows it. The time word may sit before or after the subject.

items.zh: 孩子们高兴地跑出了教室。
items.py: hái zi men gāo xìng de pǎo chū le jiào shì
items.en: The children ran happily out of the classroom.
items.why: 高兴地 is the manner of the action and goes right before the verb 跑出了, after the subject. It cannot follow the verb.

items.zh: 我听得懂他说的话。
items.py: wǒ tīng de dǒng tā shuō de huà
items.en: I can understand what he says.
items.why: 得 sits between the verb 听 and the result word 懂 to mean 'can'. The object 他说的话 can also be fronted as the topic.

items.zh: 同事们热情地欢迎新来的经理。
items.py: tóng shì men rè qíng de huān yíng xīn lái de jīng lǐ
items.en: The colleagues warmly welcomed the new manager.
items.why: 热情地 describes how they welcomed and sits before the verb 欢迎. 新来的 is a clause + 的 and must stay in front of the noun 经理.

items.s: 老师写汉字得很漂亮。
items.s_py: lǎo shī xiě hàn zì de hěn piào liang
items.zh: 老师写汉字写得很漂亮。
items.py: lǎo shī xiě hàn zì xiě de hěn piào liang
items.en: The teacher writes Chinese characters beautifully.
items.why: 得 must follow the verb, not the object 汉字. Repeat the verb: 写汉字写得很漂亮.

items.s: 我哥哥踢足球得很好。
items.s_py: wǒ gē ge tī zú qiú de hěn hǎo
items.zh: 我哥哥踢足球踢得很好。
items.py: wǒ gē ge tī zú qiú tī de hěn hǎo
items.en: My older brother plays football very well.
items.why: 踢足球 has an object, so the verb 踢 must be repeated before 得. 得 cannot attach to the object 足球.

items.s: 他汉语说得很好。
items.s_py: tā hàn yǔ shuō de hěn hǎo
items.zh: 他汉语说得很好。
items.py: tā hàn yǔ shuō de hěn hǎo
items.en: He speaks Chinese very well.
items.why: Fronting the object 汉语 lets 得 follow 说 directly, so no repeated verb is needed. It looks incomplete but is a correct pattern.

items.s: 弟弟今天起得很早。
items.s_py: dì di jīn tiān qǐ de hěn zǎo
items.zh: 弟弟今天起得很早。
items.py: dì di jīn tiān qǐ de hěn zǎo
items.en: My younger brother got up very early today.
items.why: 起 is directly followed by 得 and the judgement 很早. This is the right pattern even for a past event; no 了 is needed.

items.s: 我昨天不睡得好。
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān bù shuì de hǎo
items.zh: 我昨天睡得不好。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì de bù hǎo
items.en: I didn't sleep well yesterday.
items.why: With 得 the negative goes on the judgement, after 得: 睡得不好. Putting 不 before the verb is wrong.

items.s: 我不听得懂老师说的话。
items.s_py: wǒ bù tīng de dǒng lǎo shī shuō de huà
items.zh: 我听不懂老师说的话。
items.py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng lǎo shī shuō de huà
items.en: I can't understand what the teacher says.
items.why: The negative of 听得懂 replaces 得 with 不: 听不懂. 不 before the verb is wrong.

items.s: 黑板上的字太小了，我看不清楚。
items.s_py: hēi bǎn shàng de zì tài xiǎo le wǒ kàn bù qīng chu
items.zh: 黑板上的字太小了，我看不清楚。
items.py: hēi bǎn shàng de zì tài xiǎo le wǒ kàn bù qīng chu
items.en: The characters on the blackboard are too small; I can't see them clearly.
items.why: The 'cannot' form swaps 得 for 不: 看不清楚. This is correct; no other 不 is needed.

items.s: 他的话我听得不懂。
items.s_py: tā de huà wǒ tīng de bù dǒng
items.zh: 他的话我听不懂。
items.py: tā de huà wǒ tīng bù dǒng
items.en: I can't understand what he says.
items.why: To say 'cannot understand' you replace 得 with 不: 听不懂. 听得不懂 mixes the two patterns and is wrong.

items.s: 她高兴得一晚上都没有睡着。
items.s_py: tā gāo xìng de yī wǎn shang dōu méi yǒu shuì zháo
items.zh: 她高兴得一晚上都没有睡着。
items.py: tā gāo xìng de yī wǎn shang dōu méi yǒu shuì zháo
items.en: She was so happy that she didn't sleep all night.
items.why: 高兴 + 得 + result clause is the 'so ... that ...' pattern. Not sleeping is the result of being happy, so 得 is right.

items.s: 她买了一件漂亮地衣服。
items.s_py: tā mǎi le yī jiàn piào liang de yī fu
items.zh: 她买了一件漂亮的衣服。
items.py: tā mǎi le yī jiàn piào liang de yī fu
items.en: She bought a pretty piece of clothing.
items.why: 漂亮 describes the noun 衣服, so 的. 地 only goes before a verb.

items.s: 这是一个很有意思地故事。
items.s_py: zhè shì yī gè hěn yǒu yì si de gù shi
items.zh: 这是一个很有意思的故事。
items.py: zhè shì yī gè hěn yǒu yì si de gù shi
items.en: This is a very interesting story.
items.why: 很有意思 describes the noun 故事, so 的. 地 is wrong before a noun.

items.s: 这是妈妈做得菜。
items.s_py: zhè shì mā ma zuò de cài
items.zh: 这是妈妈做的菜。
items.py: zhè shì mā ma zuò de cài
items.en: This is the food Mum made.
items.why: 妈妈做 is a clause that describes the noun 菜, so it takes 的. 得 needs a judgement or result after it, not a noun.

items.s: 老师昨天讲的课，我都听懂了。
items.s_py: lǎo shī zuó tiān jiǎng de kè wǒ dōu tīng dǒng le
items.zh: 老师昨天讲的课，我都听懂了。
items.py: lǎo shī zuó tiān jiǎng de kè wǒ dōu tīng dǒng le
items.en: I understood all of the lesson the teacher gave yesterday.
items.why: 讲的课 is verb + 的 + noun: the clause describes the lesson. It looks like it needs 得, but a noun follows the gap, not a judgement.

items.s: 在门口等你得那个人是我的同事。
items.s_py: zài mén kǒu děng nǐ de nà ge rén shì wǒ de tóng shì
items.zh: 在门口等你的那个人是我的同事。
items.py: zài mén kǒu děng nǐ de nà ge rén shì wǒ de tóng shì
items.en: The person waiting for you at the door is my colleague.
items.why: 在门口等你 describes the person 那个人, so it needs 的. 得 cannot link a verb phrase to a noun.

items.s: 他认真地写作业。
items.s_py: tā rèn zhēn de xiě zuò yè
items.zh: 他认真地写作业。
items.py: tā rèn zhēn de xiě zuò yè
items.en: He does his homework carefully.
items.why: 认真 is the manner of 写 and sits before it, so 地 is right. The same adjective after the verb would need 得.

items.s: 经理仔细得检查了报告。
items.s_py: jīng lǐ zǐ xì de jiǎn chá le bào gào
items.zh: 经理仔细地检查了报告。
items.py: jīng lǐ zǐ xì de jiǎn chá le bào gào
items.en: The manager checked the report carefully.
items.why: 仔细 is the manner of 检查 and comes before the verb, so 地. 得 only goes after a verb or adjective.

items.s: 她把房间打扫得干干净净。
items.s_py: tā bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo de gān gān jìng jìng
items.zh: 她把房间打扫得干干净净。
items.py: tā bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo de gān gān jìng jìng
items.en: She cleaned the room spotless.
items.why: 干干净净 comes after the verb 打扫 and describes the result, so 得. A doubled adjective after a verb is still 得, not 地.

items.s: 你慢慢得说。
items.s_py: nǐ màn màn de shuō
items.zh: 你慢慢地说。
items.py: nǐ màn màn de shuō
items.en: Say it slowly.
items.why: 慢慢 sits before the verb 说 and gives its manner, so 地. 得 would need a verb before it.

items.s: 他有一双大大的眼睛，笑起来特别可爱。
items.s_py: tā yǒu yī shuāng dà dà de yǎn jing xiào qǐ lái tè bié kě ài
items.zh: 他有一双大大的眼睛，笑起来特别可爱。
items.py: tā yǒu yī shuāng dà dà de yǎn jing xiào qǐ lái tè bié kě ài
items.en: He has big eyes and looks especially cute when he smiles.
items.why: 大大 is doubled, but it describes the noun 眼睛, so 的 is correct. Doubling does not turn it into 地.

items.s: 她唱歌地很好。
items.s_py: tā chàng gē de hěn hǎo
items.zh: 她唱歌唱得很好。
items.py: tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo
items.en: She sings well.
items.why: 'Sings well' is a judgement on the singing: repeat 唱 and use 得. 地 cannot follow an object.

items.s: 同学们学得很认真。
items.s_py: tóng xué men xué de hěn rèn zhēn
items.zh: 同学们学得很认真。
items.py: tóng xué men xué de hěn rèn zhēn
items.en: The students study very conscientiously.
items.why: 很认真 judges how they study and follows the verb 学, so 得. The same word before a verb would take 地.

items.s: 他每天认真得做作业，成绩一直很好。
items.s_py: tā měi tiān rèn zhēn de zuò zuò yè chéng jì yī zhí hěn hǎo
items.zh: 他每天认真地做作业，成绩一直很好。
items.py: tā měi tiān rèn zhēn de zuò zuò yè chéng jì yī zhí hěn hǎo
items.en: He does his homework carefully every day, and his grades have always been good.
items.why: 认真 comes before the verb 做 and describes its manner, so 地. 得 would need the adjective to follow a verb.

items.s: 他很快地吃完了早饭，就去上班了。
items.s_py: tā hěn kuài de chī wán le zǎo fàn jiù qù shàng bān le
items.zh: 他很快地吃完了早饭，就去上班了。
items.py: tā hěn kuài de chī wán le zǎo fàn jiù qù shàng bān le
items.en: He finished breakfast quickly and then went to work.
items.why: 很快 describes the manner of this one action and stands before the verb 吃完, so 地. It looks wrong next to 吃得很快, but both are correct.

items.s: 上次的会议经理不讲得太详细，我们还有很多问题。
items.s_py: shàng cì de huì yì jīng lǐ bù jiǎng de tài xiáng xì wǒ men hái yǒu hěn duō wèn tí
items.zh: 上次的会议经理讲得不太详细，我们还有很多问题。
items.py: shàng cì de huì yì jīng lǐ jiǎng de bù tài xiáng xì wǒ men hái yǒu hěn duō wèn tí
items.en: In the last meeting the manager wasn't very detailed, and we still have many questions.
items.why: With 得 the negative goes on the judgement: 讲得不太详细. Putting 不 before the verb is wrong.

items.q: 妈妈给我买了一件红色___毛衣。
items.zh: 妈妈给我买了一件红色的毛衣。
items.py: mā ma gěi wǒ mǎi le yī jiàn hóng sè de máo yī
items.en: Mum bought me a red sweater.
items.why: 红色 describes the noun 毛衣, so the link is 的. 得 follows a verb or adjective that is being judged, and 地 comes before a verb; neither can sit in front of a noun.

items.q: 这是爸爸___车，不是我的。
items.zh: 这是爸爸的车，不是我的。
items.py: zhè shì bà ba de chē bù shì wǒ de
items.en: This is Dad's car, not mine.
items.why: A owner joined to the thing owned takes 的, as the later 我的 also shows. 得 and 地 never mark possession.

items.q: 商店里有很多便宜___东西。
items.zh: 商店里有很多便宜的东西。
items.py: shāng diàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō pián yi de dōng xi
items.en: There are lots of cheap things in the shop.
items.why: 便宜 describes the noun 东西 right after the gap, so 的. 地 would need a verb next, and 得 would need a verb before it.

items.q: 她喜欢那个很有名___牌子。
items.zh: 她喜欢那个很有名的牌子。
items.py: tā xǐ huan nà ge hěn yǒu míng de pái zi
items.en: She likes that very famous brand.
items.why: 很有名 describes the noun 牌子, so 的. 地 would only fit if a verb followed, and 得 only after a verb or adjective that is being judged.

items.q: 这件衣服是姐姐___，我不能穿。
items.zh: 这件衣服是姐姐的，我不能穿。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu shì jiě jie de wǒ bù néng chuān
items.en: This piece of clothing is my sister's; I can't wear it.
items.why: 姐姐的 stands for 姐姐的衣服. The noun is left out because it is obvious, but the particle is still 的; 得 and 地 do not show ownership.

items.q: 厨房里放着一个很旧___冰箱。
items.zh: 厨房里放着一个很旧的冰箱。
items.py: chú fáng lǐ fàng zhe yī gè hěn jiù de bīng xiāng
items.en: There is a very old fridge in the kitchen.
items.why: 很旧 describes the noun 冰箱. A word that describes a noun takes 的, even after 很; 地 and 得 do not attach to a noun-describing adjective.

items.q: 我想给奶奶买一件又轻又暖和___外套。
items.zh: 我想给奶奶买一件又轻又暖和的外套。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng gěi nǎi nai mǎi yī jiàn yòu qīng yòu nuǎn huo de wài tào
items.en: I want to buy Grandma a coat that is both light and warm.
items.why: 又轻又暖和 is a long description of the noun 外套, so 的 closes it. Length does not change the particle: before a noun it is always 的.

items.q: 这家店的老板正在介绍一款最新___手机。
items.zh: 这家店的老板正在介绍一款最新的手机。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn zhèng zài jiè shào yī kuǎn zuì xīn de shǒu jī
items.en: The owner of this shop is introducing the newest phone.
items.why: The gap is followed by the noun 手机 and 最新 describes it, so 的. 得 and 地 both need a verb on one side that is not what 最新 attaches to.

items.q: 我喜欢姐姐送我___花。
items.zh: 我喜欢姐姐送我的花。
items.py: wǒ xǐ huan jiě jie sòng wǒ de huā
items.en: I like the flowers my sister gave me.
items.why: 姐姐送我 describes the noun 花, so 的. The next word is a noun, which rules out 得 and 地 despite the verb 送 before the gap.

items.q: 我昨天买___苹果很甜。
items.zh: 我昨天买的苹果很甜。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de píng guǒ hěn tián
items.en: The apples I bought yesterday are sweet.
items.why: 我昨天买 modifies 苹果, so 的. 买得 would be followed by a degree word, but here the next word is a noun.

items.q: 穿蓝裙子___那个女孩是我妹妹。
items.zh: 穿蓝裙子的那个女孩是我妹妹。
items.py: chuān lán qún zi de nà ge nǚ hái shì wǒ mèi mei
items.en: The girl in the blue skirt is my younger sister.
items.why: 穿蓝裙子 describes 那个女孩, so the clause is joined to the noun by 的. A verb phrase before the gap does not make it 得.

items.q: 你想买___东西，这家店里都有。
items.zh: 你想买的东西，这家店里都有。
items.py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi de dōng xi zhè jiā diàn lǐ dōu yǒu
items.en: You can find everything you want to buy in this shop.
items.why: 你想买 modifies the noun 东西, so 的. The tempting 得 needs a judgement or result after it, not a noun.

items.q: 弟弟打碎___杯子是奶奶最喜欢的。
items.zh: 弟弟打碎的杯子是奶奶最喜欢的。
items.py: dì di dǎ suì de bēi zi shì nǎi nai zuì xǐ huan de
items.en: The cup my younger brother broke was Grandma's favourite.
items.why: 弟弟打碎 describes the noun 杯子, so 的. 打碎得 would be followed by an adjective such as 很快, not a noun.

items.q: 住在我们楼上___老人每天早上都去公园。
items.zh: 住在我们楼上的老人每天早上都去公园。
items.py: zhù zài wǒ men lóu shàng de lǎo rén měi tiān zǎo shang dōu qù gōng yuán
items.en: The old man who lives above us goes to the park every morning.
items.why: 住在我们楼上 describes 老人. The noun after the gap decides: 的. The place word 上 before the gap is not a verb that calls for 得.

items.q: 他昨天在网上买___那双鞋已经寄到家了。
items.zh: 他昨天在网上买的那双鞋已经寄到家了。
items.py: tā zuó tiān zài wǎng shàng mǎi de nà shuāng xié yǐ jīng jì dào jiā le
items.en: The pair of shoes he bought online yesterday has already been delivered to his home.
items.why: 他昨天在网上买 is a whole clause describing 那双鞋, so 的. The time and place words do not change that; only the noun that follows decides.

items.q: 我们刚搬进去___房子离地铁站很近。
items.zh: 我们刚搬进去的房子离地铁站很近。
items.py: wǒ men gāng bān jìn qù de fáng zi lí dì tiě zhàn hěn jìn
items.en: The house we have just moved into is close to the subway station.
items.why: 搬进去 ends in a direction word, which tempts 得, but 我们刚搬进去 modifies the noun 房子, so it takes 的.

items.q: 奶奶今天起___很早。
items.zh: 奶奶今天起得很早。
items.py: nǎi nai jīn tiān qǐ de hěn zǎo
items.en: Grandma got up very early today.
items.why: 很早 judges how she got up, and it follows the verb 起, so 得. 的 would need a noun next, and 地 would need a verb next.

items.q: 弟弟跑___太慢了，比赛输了。
items.zh: 弟弟跑得太慢了，比赛输了。
items.py: dì di pǎo de tài màn le bǐ sài shū le
items.en: My younger brother ran too slowly and lost the race.
items.why: 太慢了 judges the running, so it goes after the verb with 得. 地 would put 慢 before the verb as a manner word, and 的 needs a noun.

items.q: 他走___太快了，我跟不上。
items.zh: 他走得太快了，我跟不上。
items.py: tā zǒu de tài kuài le wǒ gēn bù shàng
items.en: He walks too fast; I can't keep up.
items.why: 太快了 judges how he walks, so 得 follows the verb 走. 地 would be wrong after a verb, and 的 needs a noun next.

items.q: 昨天晚上孩子们睡___不太好。
items.zh: 昨天晚上孩子们睡得不太好。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang hái zi men shuì de bù tài hǎo
items.en: The children didn't sleep very well last night.
items.why: The negative goes on the judgement: 睡得不太好. The particle after 睡 is 得, not 的 (no noun follows) or 地 (no verb follows).

items.q: 妹妹哭___很伤心，妈妈一直哄她。
items.zh: 妹妹哭得很伤心，妈妈一直哄她。
items.py: mèi mei kū de hěn shāng xīn mā ma yī zhí hǒng tā
items.en: My younger sister cried very sadly, and Mum kept comforting her.
items.why: 很伤心 judges how she cried, so it follows 哭 with 得. 地 would need the feeling word to come before the verb.

items.q: 今天他们到___特别早，商店还没开门。
items.zh: 今天他们到得特别早，商店还没开门。
items.py: jīn tiān tā men dào de tè bié zǎo shāng diàn hái méi kāi mén
items.en: They arrived especially early today; the shop wasn't open yet.
items.why: 特别早 says how early they arrived, a judgement placed after the verb 到, so 得. 的 and 地 do not link a verb to a degree word.

items.q: 爷爷这几天咳嗽___很厉害，我们都很担心。
items.zh: 爷爷这几天咳嗽得很厉害，我们都很担心。
items.py: yé ye zhè jǐ tiān ké sou de hěn lì hai wǒ men dōu hěn dān xīn
items.en: Grandpa has been coughing badly these days, and we are all worried.
items.why: 很厉害 describes how badly he coughs, so it follows the verb with 得. 地 would need a verb after it, and 的 a noun.

items.q: 孩子们今天玩___特别开心，晚上都不想回家。
items.zh: 孩子们今天玩得特别开心，晚上都不想回家。
items.py: hái zi men jīn tiān wán de tè bié kāi xīn wǎn shang dōu bù xiǎng huí jiā
items.en: The children had so much fun today that they don't want to go home in the evening.
items.why: 特别开心 judges how they played, so 得 follows 玩. 地 would put the feeling in front of the verb as a manner word.

items.q: 这家超市的牛奶卖___特别快，下午就没有了。
items.zh: 这家超市的牛奶卖得特别快，下午就没有了。
items.py: zhè jiā chāo shì de niú nǎi mài de tè bié kuài xià wǔ jiù méi yǒu le
items.en: The milk in this supermarket sells really fast; by the afternoon it is gone.
items.why: 特别快 judges how the milk sells, so it goes after the verb with 得. 的 would need a noun next, 地 a verb.

items.q: 我今天累___不想做饭。
items.zh: 我今天累得不想做饭。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān lèi de bù xiǎng zuò fàn
items.en: I'm so tired today that I don't want to cook.
items.why: 不想做饭 is the result of being tired, so adjective + 得 + result. 累 is a state, not a manner of cooking, so 地 cannot work.

items.q: 外面热___人都不想出门。
items.zh: 外面热得人都不想出门。
items.py: wài miàn rè de rén dōu bù xiǎng chū mén
items.en: It's so hot outside that nobody wants to go out.
items.why: 热 is a state and what follows is its result, so 得. 地 needs a manner adjective in front of a verb, which 热 is not here.

items.q: 孩子饿___一直哭。
items.zh: 孩子饿得一直哭。
items.py: hái zi è de yī zhí kū
items.en: The child is so hungry that he keeps crying.
items.why: 一直哭 is the consequence of being hungry, so 饿得. Hunger is a state and cannot be the manner of crying, which rules out 地.

items.q: 妈妈最近忙___没有时间看电视。
items.zh: 妈妈最近忙得没有时间看电视。
items.py: mā ma zuì jìn máng de méi yǒu shí jiān kàn diàn shì
items.en: Mum has been so busy lately that she has no time to watch TV.
items.why: 没有时间看电视 is the result of being busy, so 忙得. 忙 is a state, not a way of watching TV, so 地 fails.

items.q: 屋子里冷___我们都穿上了外套。
items.zh: 屋子里冷得我们都穿上了外套。
items.py: wū zi lǐ lěng de wǒ men dōu chuān shàng le wài tào
items.en: It was so cold in the room that we all put on coats.
items.why: The clause with its own subject 我们 is the result of the cold, so 冷得. 冷 describes the room, not how anyone put on a coat.

items.q: 最近东西贵___我都不敢多买。
items.zh: 最近东西贵得我都不敢多买。
items.py: zuì jìn dōng xi guì de wǒ dōu bù gǎn duō mǎi
items.en: Things are so expensive lately that I don't dare buy more.
items.why: 我都不敢多买 is the result of prices being high, so 贵得. 地 would make 贵 the manner of buying, which is not the meaning.

items.q: 看到价格以后，我吓___半天说不出话来。
items.zh: 看到价格以后，我吓得半天说不出话来。
items.py: kàn dào jià gé yǐ hòu wǒ xià de bàn tiān shuō bù chū huà lái
items.en: After seeing the price I was so shocked that I couldn't speak for a long while.
items.why: 说不出话来 is the result of being shocked, so 吓得. 吓 is not a manner of speaking, which excludes 地.

items.q: 小孩看见新玩具，高兴___睡不着觉。
items.zh: 小孩看见新玩具，高兴得睡不着觉。
items.py: xiǎo hái kàn jiàn xīn wán jù gāo xìng de shuì bù zháo jiào
items.en: The child was so happy about the new toy that he couldn't sleep.
items.why: 睡不着觉 is a result, and sleeping cannot be done 'happily' when it is impossible, so only 高兴得 fits; 地 would describe the manner of sleeping.

items.q: 爷爷下棋下___很好。
items.zh: 爷爷下棋下得很好。
items.py: yé ye xià qí xià de hěn hǎo
items.en: Grandpa plays chess very well.
items.why: 下棋 already has its object, so the verb is repeated and 得 follows the second 下. 得 can never come straight after the object 棋.

items.q: 爸爸开车开___很慢。
items.zh: 爸爸开车开得很慢。
items.py: bà ba kāi chē kāi de hěn màn
items.en: Dad drives slowly.
items.why: The verb 开 is repeated after its object 车, and 得 attaches to that second verb before the judgement 很慢. 地 would put 慢 in front of the verb.

items.q: 哥哥打球打___很好。
items.zh: 哥哥打球打得很好。
items.py: gē ge dǎ qiú dǎ de hěn hǎo
items.en: My older brother plays ball games very well.
items.why: With the object 球, the pattern is 打球打得很好: verb again, then 得. 地 would not fit, because 很好 is a judgement placed after the verb.

items.q: 弟弟玩游戏玩___忘了吃饭。
items.zh: 弟弟玩游戏玩得忘了吃饭。
items.py: dì di wán yóu xì wán de wàng le chī fàn
items.en: My younger brother played games so much that he forgot to eat.
items.why: 玩游戏玩 repeats the verb, then 得 links to the result 忘了吃饭. 玩 is not a manner of forgetting, so 地 is out.

items.q: 奶奶买东西买___很仔细。
items.zh: 奶奶买东西买得很仔细。
items.py: nǎi nai mǎi dōng xi mǎi de hěn zǐ xì
items.en: Grandma is very careful when she shops.
items.why: 买东西 has an object, so the verb 买 repeats and 得 attaches to it. 仔细 here is a judgement of how she shops, placed after 得.

items.q: 妹妹跳舞跳___很好看。
items.zh: 妹妹跳舞跳得很好看。
items.py: mèi mei tiào wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo kàn
items.en: My younger sister dances beautifully.
items.why: 跳舞 is verb + object, so 跳 is repeated and 得 attaches to the second 跳, followed by the judgement 很好看. 的 would need a noun next and 地 a verb.

items.q: 哥哥游泳游___比我快多了，他每个周末都去游泳。
items.zh: 哥哥游泳游得比我快多了，他每个周末都去游泳。
items.py: gē ge yóu yǒng yóu de bǐ wǒ kuài duō le tā měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù yóu yǒng
items.en: My older brother swims much faster than I do; he goes swimming every weekend.
items.why: 游泳 contains its own object, so 游 is repeated and 得 follows it, with the comparison 比我快多了 as the judgement. 的 would need a noun next.

items.q: 老师说的话我听___懂。
items.zh: 老师说的话我听得懂。
items.py: lǎo shī shuō de huà wǒ tīng de dǒng
items.en: I can understand what the teacher says.
items.why: Verb + 得 + result word means 'can'. With the meaning 'can understand', 听得懂 is right; 听不懂 would say the opposite and 听的懂 is not a form.

items.q: 菜不多，我们吃___完。
items.zh: 菜不多，我们吃得完。
items.py: cài bù duō wǒ men chī de wán
items.en: There isn't much food; we can finish it.
items.why: The cue says 'can finish', so 吃得完. 不 would turn it into 'cannot finish', which contradicts 菜不多. 地 is not used between a verb and 完.

items.q: 这件衣服太小了，我穿___下。
items.zh: 这件衣服太小了，我穿不下。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu tài xiǎo le wǒ chuān bù xià
items.en: This piece of clothing is too small; I can't fit into it.
items.why: The cue says 'can't', so 不 replaces 得 in the frame 穿不下. 得 would say it fits, which contradicts 太小了.

items.q: 这条街上有很多店，你想要的东西都买___到。
items.zh: 这条街上有很多店，你想要的东西都买得到。
items.py: zhè tiáo jiē shàng yǒu hěn duō diàn nǐ xiǎng yào de dōng xi dōu mǎi de dào
items.en: There are lots of shops on this street; you can buy everything you want.
items.why: 买得到 means 'can get', which matches the plenty of shops. 买不到 would mean 'cannot get' and contradict the context.

items.q: 他的字太小了，我看___清楚。
items.zh: 他的字太小了，我看不清楚。
items.py: tā de zì tài xiǎo le wǒ kàn bù qīng chu
items.en: His writing is too small; I can't read it clearly.
items.why: The cue says 'can't', and 太小了 explains why, so the frame is 看不清楚 with 不 in place of 得. 得 would claim that I can see it.

items.q: 这么多衣服，我一个人洗___完。
items.zh: 这么多衣服，我一个人洗不完。
items.py: zhè me duō yī fu wǒ yī gè rén xǐ bù wán
items.en: That is so many clothes; I can't wash them all on my own.
items.why: 这么多 and 一个人 point to 'cannot', so 不 replaces 得 in 洗不完. 洗得完 would mean it is manageable.

items.q: 小字我看___见，不用戴眼镜。
items.zh: 小字我看得见，不用戴眼镜。
items.py: xiǎo zì wǒ kàn de jiàn bù yòng dài yǎn jìng
items.en: I can see small print; I don't need glasses.
items.why: 不用戴眼镜 shows that the person can see, so 看得见. 看不见 would mean cannot see and clash with the second clause.

items.q: 只要攒一年的钱，我们就买___起那套房子。
items.zh: 只要攒一年的钱，我们就买得起那套房子。
items.py: zhǐ yào zǎn yī nián de qián wǒ men jiù mǎi de qǐ nà tào fáng zi
items.en: If we save for a year, we will be able to afford that flat.
items.why: 只要……就 sets up a condition under which it becomes possible, so 买得起. 买不起 would contradict the 'as soon as we save' meaning.

items.q: 这个沙发太大，门这么小，我们肯定搬___进去。
items.zh: 这个沙发太大，门这么小，我们肯定搬不进去。
items.py: zhè ge shā fā tài dà mén zhè me xiǎo wǒ men kěn dìng bān bù jìn qù
items.en: This sofa is too big and the door is so small; we definitely can't get it in.
items.why: 太大 and 这么小 give the reason for 'cannot', so 不 takes the place of 得 in 搬不进去. 得 would claim that it fits.

items.q: 弟弟小声___告诉我，妈妈给他买了新书包。
items.zh: 弟弟小声地告诉我，妈妈给他买了新书包。
items.py: dì di xiǎo shēng de gào su wǒ mā ma gěi tā mǎi le xīn shū bāo
items.en: My younger brother whispered to me that Mum had bought him a new school bag.
items.why: 小声 is the manner in which he told me and sits before the verb 告诉, so 地. 得 needs a verb right before it, and none stands before 小声 here.

items.q: 弟弟认真___整理自己的房间。
items.zh: 弟弟认真地整理自己的房间。
items.py: dì di rèn zhēn de zhěng lǐ zì jǐ de fáng jiān
items.en: My younger brother is carefully tidying his own room.
items.why: 认真 describes how he tidies and comes before the verb 整理, so 地. 得 requires a verb before the gap.

items.q: 售货员热情___向我们介绍了这件衣服。
items.zh: 售货员热情地向我们介绍了这件衣服。
items.py: shòu huò yuán rè qíng de xiàng wǒ men jiè shào le zhè jiàn yī fu
items.en: The shop assistant warmly introduced this piece of clothing to us.
items.why: 热情 is the manner of 介绍, a verb phrase that follows the gap, so 地. 得 would need 热情 to judge a verb that precedes it.

items.q: 爸爸小心___把花瓶放在桌子上。
items.zh: 爸爸小心地把花瓶放在桌子上。
items.py: bà ba xiǎo xīn de bǎ huā píng fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: Dad carefully put the vase on the table.
items.why: 小心 is how Dad did the placing and sits before the 把 phrase and verb, so 地. 得 would need a verb right before it.

items.q: 爷爷安静___坐在沙发上看报纸。
items.zh: 爷爷安静地坐在沙发上看报纸。
items.py: yé ye ān jìng de zuò zài shā fā shàng kàn bào zhǐ
items.en: Grandpa sat quietly on the sofa reading the newspaper.
items.why: 安静 describes the manner of 坐 and comes before it, so 地. Only a verb before the gap could make 得 possible.

items.q: 妈妈耐心___听完了孩子的解释，然后笑了。
items.zh: 妈妈耐心地听完了孩子的解释，然后笑了。
items.py: mā ma nài xīn de tīng wán le hái zi de jiě shì rán hòu xiào le
items.en: Mum listened patiently to her child's explanation to the end, and then smiled.
items.why: 耐心 is the manner of listening and comes before the verb 听完, so 地. 得 would have to follow a verb such as 听.

items.q: 老板抱歉___告诉顾客，这个已经卖完了。
items.zh: 老板抱歉地告诉顾客，这个已经卖完了。
items.py: lǎo bǎn bào qiàn de gào su gù kè zhè ge yǐ jīng mài wán le
items.en: The boss apologetically told the customer that this was already sold out.
items.why: 抱歉 is the manner in which he told the customer, and a verb follows, so 地. 得 needs a verb before it.

items.q: 你慢慢___说，我听不懂。
items.zh: 你慢慢地说，我听不懂。
items.py: nǐ màn màn de shuō wǒ tīng bù dǒng
items.en: Speak slowly; I can't follow.
items.why: 慢慢 is doubled but what decides is position: it comes before the verb 说, so 地. After a verb it would be 得.

items.q: 妈妈轻轻___把宝宝放在床上。
items.zh: 妈妈轻轻地把宝宝放在床上。
items.py: mā ma qīng qīng de bǎ bǎo bao fàng zài chuáng shàng
items.en: Mum gently put the baby on the bed.
items.why: 轻轻 describes the manner of the placing and comes before the verb phrase, so 地. 得 would require a verb before the gap.

items.q: 桌子上放着一个圆圆___蛋糕。
items.zh: 桌子上放着一个圆圆的蛋糕。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yī gè yuán yuán de dàn gāo
items.en: There is a round cake on the table.
items.why: 圆圆 describes the noun 蛋糕, so 的. 地 is only for words that go before a verb.

items.q: 妈妈把房间打扫___干干净净。
items.zh: 妈妈把房间打扫得干干净净。
items.py: mā ma bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo de gān gān jìng jìng
items.en: Mum cleaned the room spotless.
items.why: 干干净净 is the result of 打扫, so it follows the verb with 得. Doubling does not make it 地, because 打扫 comes right before the gap.

items.q: 她把头发梳___整整齐齐，才出门。
items.zh: 她把头发梳得整整齐齐，才出门。
items.py: tā bǎ tóu fa shū de zhěng zhěng qí qí cái chū mén
items.en: She combed her hair neatly before going out.
items.why: 整整齐齐 describes the result of 梳, placed after the verb, so 得. 地 would put the word before the verb, as in 整整齐齐地梳。

items.q: 他是个很认真___学生，每天都做作业。
items.zh: 他是个很认真的学生，每天都做作业。
items.py: tā shì gè hěn rèn zhēn de xué sheng měi tiān dōu zuò zuò yè
items.en: He is a very conscientious student and does his homework every day.
items.why: 认真 is often seen with 地, but here the next word is the noun 学生, so it must be 的.

items.q: 弟弟每天都认真___做作业。
items.zh: 弟弟每天都认真地做作业。
items.py: dì di měi tiān dōu rèn zhēn de zuò zuò yè
items.en: My younger brother does his homework carefully every day.
items.why: 认真 comes before the verb 做, describing the manner of doing it, so 地. After a verb it would be 得, and before a noun 的.

items.q: 弟弟做作业做___很认真。
items.zh: 弟弟做作业做得很认真。
items.py: dì di zuò zuò yè zuò de hěn rèn zhēn
items.en: My younger brother does his homework very conscientiously.
items.why: The verb 做 is repeated after its object, and 很认真 is a judgement of how he does it, so 得. The same 认真 takes 地 before a verb.

items.q: 请给我一个清楚___回答。
items.zh: 请给我一个清楚的回答。
items.py: qǐng gěi wǒ yī gè qīng chu de huí dá
items.en: Please give me a clear answer.
items.why: 清楚 describes the noun 回答, so 的. The same adjective would take 地 before a verb (清楚地说) and 得 after one (说得清楚).

items.q: 请你把问题清楚___告诉我。
items.zh: 请你把问题清楚地告诉我。
items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ wèn tí qīng chu de gào su wǒ
items.en: Please tell me the problem clearly.
items.why: 清楚 sits before the verb 告诉 and says how to tell, so 地. 的 needs a noun after it, and 得 needs a verb before it.

items.q: 坐在前排，我们看___很清楚。
items.zh: 坐在前排，我们看得很清楚。
items.py: zuò zài qián pái wǒ men kàn de hěn qīng chu
items.en: Sitting in the front row, we could see very clearly.
items.why: 很清楚 judges how well they see, and it comes after the verb 看, so 得. The same word before a noun takes 的 and before a verb 地.

items.q: 她努力___工作，想给家里买一套房子。
items.zh: 她努力地工作，想给家里买一套房子。
items.py: tā nǔ lì de gōng zuò xiǎng gěi jiā lǐ mǎi yī tào fáng zi
items.en: She works hard because she wants to buy a flat for her family.
items.why: 努力 is the manner of working and comes before the verb 工作, so 地. 得 would require 努力 to follow a verb.

items.s: 妈妈做的菜比饭店的还好吃。
items.s_py: mā ma zuò de cài bǐ fàn diàn de hái hǎo chī
items.zh: 妈妈做的菜比饭店的还好吃。
items.py: mā ma zuò de cài bǐ fàn diàn de hái hǎo chī
items.en: The food Mum makes is even tastier than the restaurant's.
items.why: Correct: 妈妈做 describes the noun 菜, so 的. A verb before 的 does not make it 得.

items.s: 我买的比她买的便宜。
items.s_py: wǒ mǎi de bǐ tā mǎi de pián yi
items.zh: 我买的比她买的便宜。
items.py: wǒ mǎi de bǐ tā mǎi de pián yi
items.en: What I bought is cheaper than what she bought.
items.why: Correct: both 买的 stand for 'the thing bought' with the noun left out, so 的 is right.

items.s: 这是姐姐昨天买得衣服。
items.s_py: zhè shì jiě jie zuó tiān mǎi de yī fu
items.zh: 这是姐姐昨天买的衣服。
items.py: zhè shì jiě jie zuó tiān mǎi de yī fu
items.en: This is the clothing my older sister bought yesterday.
items.why: The gap is followed by the noun 衣服, so the clause 姐姐昨天买 is joined with 的. 得 needs a judgement word after it.

items.s: 我不喜欢太甜的东西。
items.s_py: wǒ bù xǐ huan tài tián de dōng xi
items.zh: 我不喜欢太甜的东西。
items.py: wǒ bù xǐ huan tài tián de dōng xi
items.en: I don't like things that are too sweet.
items.why: Correct: 太甜 describes the noun 东西, so 的 is right even though the phrase starts with 太.

items.s: 这是一件很便宜得衣服。
items.s_py: zhè shì yī jiàn hěn pián yi de yī fu
items.zh: 这是一件很便宜的衣服。
items.py: zhè shì yī jiàn hěn pián yi de yī fu
items.en: This is a very cheap piece of clothing.
items.why: 得 follows a verb and leads to a judgement; here the adjective 便宜 describes the noun 衣服, so it must be 的.

items.s: 她送给我一条很漂亮地裙子。
items.s_py: tā sòng gěi wǒ yī tiáo hěn piào liang de qún zi
items.zh: 她送给我一条很漂亮的裙子。
items.py: tā sòng gěi wǒ yī tiáo hěn piào liang de qún zi
items.en: She gave me a very pretty skirt.
items.why: 地 goes before a verb. The word after the gap is the noun 裙子, so 很漂亮 needs 的.

items.s: 弟弟哭得眼睛都红了。
items.s_py: dì di kū de yǎn jing dōu hóng le
items.zh: 弟弟哭得眼睛都红了。
items.py: dì di kū de yǎn jing dōu hóng le
items.en: My younger brother cried until his eyes were red.
items.why: Correct: 得 follows the verb 哭 and introduces the result 眼睛都红了. No 了 is needed after 哭.

items.s: 奶奶今天不起得早。
items.s_py: nǎi nai jīn tiān bù qǐ de zǎo
items.zh: 奶奶今天起得不早。
items.py: nǎi nai jīn tiān qǐ de bù zǎo
items.en: Grandma didn't get up early today.
items.why: The negative belongs to the judgement after 得: 起得不早. 不 cannot stand before the verb in this pattern.

items.s: 哥哥跑地很快。
items.s_py: gē ge pǎo de hěn kuài
items.zh: 哥哥跑得很快。
items.py: gē ge pǎo de hěn kuài
items.en: My older brother runs fast.
items.why: 很快 judges how he runs, and it follows the verb 跑, so 得. 地 only goes before a verb.

items.s: 妹妹跳得舞很好。
items.s_py: mèi mei tiào de wǔ hěn hǎo
items.zh: 妹妹跳舞跳得很好。
items.py: mèi mei tiào wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo
items.en: My younger sister dances well.
items.why: 得 must come right after the verb being judged and cannot be followed by the object 舞. Repeat the verb: 跳舞跳得很好.

items.s: 妈妈忙地没时间吃饭。
items.s_py: mā ma máng de méi shí jiān chī fàn
items.zh: 妈妈忙得没时间吃饭。
items.py: mā ma máng de méi shí jiān chī fàn
items.en: Mum is so busy that she has no time to eat.
items.why: 没时间吃饭 is the result of being busy, so 忙得. 地 would make 忙 the manner of eating.

items.s: 她高兴得一晚上没睡着。
items.s_py: tā gāo xìng de yī wǎn shang méi shuì zháo
items.zh: 她高兴得一晚上没睡着。
items.py: tā gāo xìng de yī wǎn shang méi shuì zháo
items.en: She was so happy that she didn't sleep all night.
items.why: Correct: 没睡着 is a result, so 高兴得 is right. 高兴地 would describe how she did something.

items.s: 弟弟困地眼睛都睁不开了。
items.s_py: dì di kùn de yǎn jing dōu zhēng bù kāi le
items.zh: 弟弟困得眼睛都睁不开了。
items.py: dì di kùn de yǎn jing dōu zhēng bù kāi le
items.en: My younger brother was so sleepy that he couldn't keep his eyes open.
items.why: 眼睛都睁不开了 is the result of being sleepy, so 困得. 困 is a state and cannot be a manner before a verb, so 地 fails.

items.s: 姐姐写字写得很漂亮。
items.s_py: jiě jie xiě zì xiě de hěn piào liang
items.zh: 姐姐写字写得很漂亮。
items.py: jiě jie xiě zì xiě de hěn piào liang
items.en: My older sister writes beautifully.
items.why: Correct: the object 字 is followed by the repeated verb 写, and 得 attaches to that second verb.

items.s: 妹妹唱歌得很好听。
items.s_py: mèi mei chàng gē de hěn hǎo tīng
items.zh: 妹妹唱歌唱得很好听。
items.py: mèi mei chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo tīng
items.en: My younger sister sings beautifully.
items.why: 得 cannot follow the object 歌. The verb 唱 must be repeated first: 唱歌唱得.

items.s: 弟弟写作业得很认真。
items.s_py: dì di xiě zuò yè de hěn rèn zhēn
items.zh: 弟弟写作业写得很认真。
items.py: dì di xiě zuò yè xiě de hěn rèn zhēn
items.en: My younger brother does his homework very conscientiously.
items.why: 作业 is the object, so 得 cannot come right after it. Repeat 写 before 得.

items.s: 他汉语说得很流利，不像刚学了一年。
items.s_py: tā hàn yǔ shuō de hěn liú lì bù xiàng gāng xué le yī nián
items.zh: 他汉语说得很流利，不像刚学了一年。
items.py: tā hàn yǔ shuō de hěn liú lì bù xiàng gāng xué le yī nián
items.en: He speaks Chinese very fluently; you wouldn't think he has only just studied for a year.
items.why: Correct: the object 汉语 is moved to the front as a topic, so 说 does not need repeating and 得 follows the verb.

items.s: 这个箱子太重了，我一个人搬不动。
items.s_py: zhè ge xiāng zi tài zhòng le wǒ yī gè rén bān bù dòng
items.zh: 这个箱子太重了，我一个人搬不动。
items.py: zhè ge xiāng zi tài zhòng le wǒ yī gè rén bān bù dòng
items.en: This box is too heavy; I can't move it on my own.
items.why: Correct: 'cannot' swaps 得 for 不 in 搬不动. No other 不 is needed anywhere.

items.s: 钱不够，我们买不起那个冰箱。
items.s_py: qián bù gòu wǒ men mǎi bù qǐ nà ge bīng xiāng
items.zh: 钱不够，我们买不起那个冰箱。
items.py: qián bù gòu wǒ men mǎi bù qǐ nà ge bīng xiāng
items.en: We don't have enough money; we can't afford that fridge.
items.why: Correct: 买不起 is the negative of 买得起, with 不 in place of 得.

items.s: 我不看得懂这个说明书。
items.s_py: wǒ bù kàn de dǒng zhè ge shuō míng shū
items.zh: 我看不懂这个说明书。
items.py: wǒ kàn bù dǒng zhè ge shuō míng shū
items.en: I can't understand these instructions.
items.why: 'Cannot' is formed by replacing 得 with 不: 看不懂. Putting 不 before the verb is not allowed.

items.s: 这么多菜，我吃得不完。
items.s_py: zhè me duō cài wǒ chī de bù wán
items.zh: 这么多菜，我吃不完。
items.py: zhè me duō cài wǒ chī bù wán
items.en: That's so much food; I can't finish it.
items.why: The 'cannot' form is 吃不完, with 不 instead of 得. 得不 does not occur in this frame.

items.s: 售货员慢慢地走过来，笑着问我们要什么。
items.s_py: shòu huò yuán màn màn de zǒu guò lái xiào zhe wèn wǒ men yào shén me
items.zh: 售货员慢慢地走过来，笑着问我们要什么。
items.py: shòu huò yuán màn màn de zǒu guò lái xiào zhe wèn wǒ men yào shén me
items.en: The shop assistant walked over slowly and asked us with a smile what we wanted.
items.why: Correct: 慢慢 comes before the verb 走过来 as its manner, so 地.

items.s: 老师认真得听学生的回答。
items.s_py: lǎo shī rèn zhēn de tīng xué sheng de huí dá
items.zh: 老师认真地听学生的回答。
items.py: lǎo shī rèn zhēn de tīng xué sheng de huí dá
items.en: The teacher listens carefully to the students' answers.
items.why: 认真 sits before the verb 听 and describes how it is done, so 地. 得 would need a verb in front of it.

items.s: 孩子们高高兴兴地去超市买玩具。
items.s_py: hái zi men gāo gāo xìng xìng de qù chāo shì mǎi wán jù
items.zh: 孩子们高高兴兴地去超市买玩具。
items.py: hái zi men gāo gāo xìng xìng de qù chāo shì mǎi wán jù
items.en: The children went happily to the supermarket to buy toys.
items.why: Correct: the doubled adjective comes before the verb 去, so 地.

items.s: 她把客厅打扫得干干净净。
items.s_py: tā bǎ kè tīng dǎ sǎo de gān gān jìng jìng
items.zh: 她把客厅打扫得干干净净。
items.py: tā bǎ kè tīng dǎ sǎo de gān gān jìng jìng
items.en: She cleaned the living room spotless.
items.why: Correct: 干干净净 is the result of 打扫, so it takes 得 even though it is doubled.

items.zh: 我喜欢妈妈做的那道菜。
items.py: wǒ xǐ huan mā ma zuò de nà dào cài
items.en: I like the dish Mum made.
items.why: 妈妈做 is a clause that describes 那道菜, so 的 follows 做 and the noun comes last. 得 is a distractor because it needs a judgement word after it. The whole 妈妈做的那道菜 can also be fronted as the topic.

items.zh: 爷爷慢慢地走进房间。
items.py: yé ye màn màn de zǒu jìn fáng jiān
items.en: Grandpa walked slowly into the room.
items.why: 慢慢 describes the manner and goes before the verb 走进, joined by 地. The adverbial cannot come after the verb.

items.zh: 弟弟洗衣服洗得很干净。
items.py: dì di xǐ yī fu xǐ de hěn gān jìng
items.en: My younger brother gets clothes very clean when he washes them.
items.why: 得 cannot follow the object 衣服, so the verb 洗 is repeated and 得 attaches to the second 洗, followed by the judgement.

items.zh: 我听不懂他说的话。
items.py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng tā shuō de huà
items.en: I can't understand what he says.
items.why: 'Cannot' is 听不懂, with 不 in the place of 得 right after the verb. The object may also be fronted as the topic.

items.q: 姐姐游泳___比我快多了。
items.zh: 姐姐游泳游得比我快多了。
items.py: jiě jie yóu yǒng yóu de bǐ wǒ kuài duō le
items.en: My older sister swims much faster than I do.
items.why: 游泳 has the object built in, so only 游 is repeated: 游泳游得比我快多了. 得 right after 泳 is wrong.

items.q: 他咳嗽___晚上睡不着觉。
items.zh: 他咳嗽得晚上睡不着觉。
items.py: tā ké sou de wǎn shang shuì bù zháo jiào
items.en: He coughs so much that he can't sleep at night.
items.why: The extent of the coughing leads to a result, 睡不着觉, so 得. 地 would make 睡不着觉 the manner of coughing, which makes no sense.

items.zh: 我累得一句话都不想说。
items.py: wǒ lèi de yī jù huà dōu bù xiǎng shuō
items.en: I'm so tired I don't even want to say a word.
items.why: 累得 introduces the result clause 一句话都不想说. 得 sits directly after the adjective 累.

items.s: 他今天不起得早。
items.s_py: tā jīn tiān bù qǐ de zǎo
items.zh: 他今天起得不早。
items.py: tā jīn tiān qǐ de bù zǎo
items.en: He didn't get up early today.
items.why: With 得 the negative goes on the judgement, after 得: 起得不早. 不起得 is never used.

items.s: 病人慢慢地睁开了眼睛。
items.zh: 病人慢慢地睁开了眼睛。
items.py: bìng rén màn màn de zhēng kāi le yǎn jing
items.en: The patient slowly opened his eyes.
items.why: 慢慢 is the manner of 睁开 and stands before the verb, so 地 is correct.

items.s: 这位医生看病看得非常仔细。
items.zh: 这位医生看病看得非常仔细。
items.py: zhè wèi yī shēng kàn bìng kàn de fēi cháng zǐ xì
items.en: This doctor examines patients very carefully.
items.why: 看病 has an object, so the verb is repeated before 得: 看病看得非常仔细. This is correct.

items.q: 虽然医生说我的病不严重，但是我这几天一直睡___很差。
items.zh: 虽然医生说我的病不严重，但是我这几天一直睡得很差。
items.py: suī rán yī shēng shuō wǒ de bìng bù yán zhòng dàn shì wǒ zhè jǐ tiān yī zhí shuì de hěn chà
items.en: Although the doctor says my illness isn't serious, I've been sleeping badly these days.
items.why: 睡 + 得 + 很差 judges the quality of sleep. 地 would sit before a verb, and no noun follows for 的.

items.s: 雪慢慢得融化了。
items.s_py: xuě màn màn de róng huà le
items.zh: 雪慢慢地融化了。
items.py: xuě màn màn de róng huà le
items.en: The snow slowly melted.
items.why: 慢慢 describes the manner of 融化 and precedes the verb, so 地. 得 would have to follow 融化.

items.s: 穿白衣服的是我们的医生。
items.zh: 穿白衣服的是我们的医生。
items.py: chuān bái yī fu de shì wǒ men de yī shēng
items.en: The one in white is our doctor.
items.why: 穿白衣服 modifies an understood noun (the person), so 的 is correct even though the noun is left out. 我们的医生 uses 的 for ownership.

items.q: 今天太热了，我热___不想吃饭。
items.zh: 今天太热了，我热得不想吃饭。
items.py: jīn tiān tài rè le wǒ rè de bù xiǎng chī fàn
items.en: It's too hot today; I'm so hot I don't feel like eating.
items.why: 热 + 得 + result clause: 热得不想吃饭. 不想吃饭 is the result of the heat, not the manner of any action, so 地 is out.

items.q: 我喜欢凉快___秋天。
items.zh: 我喜欢凉快的秋天。
items.py: wǒ xǐ huan liáng kuai de qiū tiān
items.en: I like the cool autumn.
items.why: 秋天 is a noun, so the describing word 凉快 joins it with 的. 得 needs a verb or adjective before it and a comment after it, and 地 needs a verb after it.

items.q: 孩子们高高兴兴___玩雪。
items.zh: 孩子们高高兴兴地玩雪。
items.py: hái zi men gāo gāo xìng xìng de wán xuě
items.en: The children happily played in the snow.
items.why: 高高兴兴 is the manner of 玩雪 and comes before the verb, so 地. 得 would require 玩 first, as in 玩得高高兴兴.

items.s: 他很认真地吃完了医生开的药。
items.zh: 他很认真地吃完了医生开的药。
items.py: tā hěn rèn zhēn de chī wán le yī shēng kāi de yào
items.en: He conscientiously took all the medicine the doctor prescribed.
items.why: Both particles are right: 认真地 stands before the verb 吃完, and 开的药 is clause + 的 + noun.

items.q: 我饿___肚子都叫了。
items.zh: 我饿得肚子都叫了。
items.py: wǒ è de dù zi dōu jiào le
items.en: I'm so hungry that my stomach is rumbling.
items.why: 饿 + 得 + clause: 肚子都叫了 is the result of being hungry. 的 would need a noun, which 肚子 is not describing.

items.q: 医生认真___给我检查身体。
items.zh: 医生认真地给我检查身体。
items.py: yī shēng rèn zhēn de gěi wǒ jiǎn chá shēn tǐ
items.en: The doctor examined me carefully.
items.why: 认真 is the manner of the action 检查, and the verb phrase follows, so 地. 得 belongs after a verb with a judgement.

items.q: 外面的雪下___路都看不见了。
items.zh: 外面的雪下得路都看不见了。
items.py: wài miàn de xuě xià de lù dōu kàn bù jiàn le
items.en: It snowed so much that the roads can't be seen anymore.
items.why: 下 + 得 + a result clause with its own subject 路. 地 would need a verb of manner right after it, but 路都看不见了 is a result.

items.q: 雨下得太大了，我们今天肯定回___去了。
items.zh: 雨下得太大了，我们今天肯定回不去了。
items.py: yǔ xià de tài dà le wǒ men jīn tiān kěn dìng huí bù qù le
items.en: It's raining so hard that we definitely can't go back today.
items.why: Rain too heavy means 'cannot': 回不去了. 得 would say we can get back, contradicting the first clause.

items.s: 昨天的雪下得真大。
items.zh: 昨天的雪下得真大。
items.py: zuó tiān de xuě xià de zhēn dà
items.en: It snowed really heavily yesterday.
items.why: 的 links 昨天 to the noun 雪, and 得 links the verb 下 to the judgement 真大. Each particle is in its proper spot.

items.s: 他今天起得比平时早。
items.zh: 他今天起得比平时早。
items.py: tā jīn tiān qǐ de bǐ píng shí zǎo
items.en: He got up earlier than usual today.
items.why: 起 + 得 + comment (here a comparison) is correct. The comment after 得 does not need 很.

items.q: 他认真___吃药。
items.zh: 他认真地吃药。
items.py: tā rèn zhēn de chī yào
items.en: He takes his medicine conscientiously.
items.why: 认真 describes the manner of the action 吃药, so 地 goes between them. 得 comes after a verb, not before one.

items.q: 冬天很冷，我要穿厚___衣服。
items.zh: 冬天很冷，我要穿厚的衣服。
items.py: dōng tiān hěn lěng wǒ yào chuān hòu de yī fu
items.en: It's cold in winter, so I need to wear thick clothes.
items.why: 厚 describes the noun 衣服, so the link is 的. 得 and 地 would need a verb or complement around them, but 衣服 is a plain noun.

items.q: 她小心___走在雪地上。
items.zh: 她小心地走在雪地上。
items.py: tā xiǎo xīn de zǒu zài xuě dì shàng
items.en: She walked carefully on the snow.
items.why: 小心 is the manner of walking and stands before the verb 走, so 地. 得 would need 走 first.

items.q: 天太黑了，我们看___见路。
items.zh: 天太黑了，我们看不见路。
items.py: tiān tài hēi le wǒ men kàn bù jiàn lù
items.en: It's too dark; we can't see the road.
items.why: 太黑 means we cannot see, so 得 turns into 不: 看不见. 看得见 would claim the opposite.

items.q: 我昨天晚上睡___不好。
items.zh: 我昨天晚上睡得不好。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang shuì de bù hǎo
items.en: I didn't sleep well last night.
items.why: Verb + 得 + judgement: 睡得不好. 的 needs a noun after it, and 地 needs a verb after it; 不好 is neither.

items.q: 他很快___吃完了药。
items.zh: 他很快地吃完了药。
items.py: tā hěn kuài de chī wán le yào
items.en: He quickly finished taking the medicine.
items.why: 很快 describes how he took the medicine and stands before the verb 吃, so 地. 得 would have to follow the verb.

items.q: 感冒___时候要多喝水。
items.zh: 感冒的时候要多喝水。
items.py: gǎn mào de shí hou yào duō hē shuǐ
items.en: When you have a cold, drink plenty of water.
items.why: 感冒 is a verb, but the next word is the noun 时候, so the time clause is joined with 的. 地 and 得 are ruled out by the following noun.

items.q: 他跳舞___真好看。
items.zh: 他跳舞跳得真好看。
items.py: tā tiào wǔ tiào de zhēn hǎo kàn
items.en: He dances beautifully.
items.why: 跳舞 is verb + object, so 跳 is repeated: 跳舞跳得真好看. 得 directly after 舞 is not possible.

items.q: 小王跑___很慢，因为他的腿疼。
items.zh: 小王跑得很慢，因为他的腿疼。
items.py: xiǎo wáng pǎo de hěn màn yīn wèi tā de tuǐ téng
items.en: Xiao Wang runs slowly because his leg hurts.
items.why: 很慢 judges how he runs and follows the verb 跑, so 得. 地 would put the manner word before the verb instead.

items.s: 今天太阳升地很早。
items.s_py: jīn tiān tài yáng shēng de hěn zǎo
items.zh: 今天太阳升得很早。
items.py: jīn tiān tài yáng shēng de hěn zǎo
items.en: The sun rose very early today.
items.why: 升 is a verb and 很早 is the judgement after it, so 得. 地 cannot follow a verb to introduce a complement.

items.q: 她每天都很努力___锻炼身体。
items.zh: 她每天都很努力地锻炼身体。
items.py: tā měi tiān dōu hěn nǔ lì de duàn liàn shēn tǐ
items.en: She works hard at exercising every day.
items.why: 很努力 is the manner of the verb 锻炼, so 地. The same word after a verb would take 得 instead.

items.q: 她说汉语___很流利，没有人觉得她是外国人。
items.zh: 她说汉语说得很流利，没有人觉得她是外国人。
items.py: tā shuō hàn yǔ shuō de hěn liú lì méi yǒu rén jué de tā shì wài guó rén
items.en: She speaks Chinese so fluently that nobody thinks she's a foreigner.
items.why: With the object 汉语 the verb is repeated: 说汉语说得很流利. 得 cannot attach to 汉语.

items.q: 感冒好了以后，我又闻___到花香了。
items.zh: 感冒好了以后，我又闻得到花香了。
items.py: gǎn mào hǎo le yǐ hòu wǒ yòu wén de dào huā xiāng le
items.en: After my cold got better, I could smell the flowers again.
items.why: Recovered from the cold, so 'can smell again': 闻得到. 闻不到 would mean the nose is still blocked, which 好了 and 又 rule out.

items.q: 你要好好___休息，不要熬夜。
items.zh: 你要好好地休息，不要熬夜。
items.py: nǐ yào hǎo hǎo de xiū xi bù yào áo yè
items.en: You must rest properly; don't stay up late.
items.why: 好好 describes how to rest and stands before the verb 休息, so 地. 得 would have to follow a verb.

items.s: 我妈妈做饭得很好吃。
items.s_py: wǒ mā ma zuò fàn de hěn hǎo chī
items.zh: 我妈妈做饭做得很好吃。
items.py: wǒ mā ma zuò fàn zuò de hěn hǎo chī
items.en: My mum cooks very tasty food.
items.why: 得 cannot follow the object 饭. The verb 做 is repeated: 做饭做得很好吃.

items.zh: 医生说的话我听得懂。
items.py: yī shēng shuō de huà wǒ tīng de dǒng
items.en: I can understand what the doctor says.
items.why: 医生说的话 is clause + 的 + noun, topicalised or after the verb; 听得懂 keeps 得 between the verb and the result.

items.q: 他锻炼___很努力，所以身体越来越好。
items.zh: 他锻炼得很努力，所以身体越来越好。
items.py: tā duàn liàn de hěn nǔ lì suǒ yǐ shēn tǐ yuè lái yuè hǎo
items.en: He exercises very diligently, so his health is getting better and better.
items.why: Here 努力 follows the verb 锻炼 as a judgement of how he does it, so 得. Before the verb it would be 地.

items.s: 弟弟很好地游泳。
items.s_py: dì di hěn hǎo de yóu yǒng
items.zh: 弟弟游泳游得很好。
items.py: dì di yóu yǒng yóu de hěn hǎo
items.en: My younger brother swims well.
items.why: English 'well' judges the swimming, so Chinese puts it after the verb with 得. 很好地游泳 is not Chinese.

items.q: 地上有一层厚厚___雪。
items.zh: 地上有一层厚厚的雪。
items.py: dì shàng yǒu yī céng hòu hòu de xuě
