items.en: There is a thick layer of snow on the ground.
items.why: The doubled 厚厚 describes the noun 雪, so 的. The same doubled word before a verb would take 地.

items.q: 他的感冒好___真快。
items.zh: 他的感冒好得真快。
items.py: tā de gǎn mào hǎo de zhēn kuài
items.en: His cold got better really fast.
items.why: An adjective or verb of change + 得 + comment on speed: 好得真快. 的 or 地 would not link 好 with the adjective 真快.

items.s: 夏天是我最喜欢地季节。
items.s_py: xià tiān shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de jì jié
items.zh: 夏天是我最喜欢的季节。
items.py: xià tiān shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de jì jié
items.en: Summer is my favourite season.
items.why: 最喜欢 describes the noun 季节, so 的. 地 can only come before a verb.

items.q: 医生说汉语___不太流利，但是我们听得懂。
items.zh: 医生说汉语说得不太流利，但是我们听得懂。
items.py: yī shēng shuō hàn yǔ shuō de bù tài liú lì dàn shì wǒ men tīng de dǒng
items.en: The doctor doesn't speak Chinese very fluently, but we can understand him.
items.why: With the object 汉语, the verb must be repeated: 说汉语说得不太流利. 得 cannot follow 汉语 directly.

items.q: 早上起来，窗外白白___一片，昨晚下雪了。
items.zh: 早上起来，窗外白白的一片，昨晚下雪了。
items.py: zǎo shang qǐ lái chuāng wài bái bái de yī piàn zuó wǎn xià xuě le
items.en: When I got up in the morning, outside the window was a stretch of white; it snowed last night.
items.why: 白白 describes the stretch (一片) outside, so 的. There is no verb after the gap for 地.

items.q: 他吃饭___很慢。
items.zh: 他吃饭吃得很慢。
items.py: tā chī fàn chī de hěn màn
items.en: He eats slowly.
items.why: 吃饭 has an object, so the verb 吃 returns before 得: 吃饭吃得很慢. 吃饭得很慢 breaks the rule that 得 must follow the verb.

items.q: 那个每天早上在公园里打太极拳___老人看起来身体特别好。
items.zh: 那个每天早上在公园里打太极拳的老人看起来身体特别好。
items.py: nà gè měi tiān zǎo shang zài gōng yuán lǐ dǎ tài jí quán de lǎo rén kàn qǐ lái shēn tǐ tè bié hǎo
items.en: The old man who does tai chi in the park every morning looks to be in excellent health.
items.why: A long clause ending in a verb phrase still modifies the noun 老人 with 的. Verb + 得 would be followed by a judgement, not by 老人.

items.q: 春天的雨细细的，轻轻___落在窗户上。
items.zh: 春天的雨细细的，轻轻地落在窗户上。
items.py: chūn tiān de yǔ xì xì de qīng qīng de luò zài chuāng hu shàng
items.en: The spring rain is fine and falls softly on the window.
items.why: 轻轻 modifies the verb 落, so 地. 细细的 earlier is a predicate before a comma, which takes 的.

items.q: 医生给了我一张很长___药单。
items.zh: 医生给了我一张很长的药单。
items.py: yī shēng gěi le wǒ yī zhāng hěn cháng de yào dān
items.en: The doctor gave me a very long prescription.
items.why: 很长 describes the noun 药单, so 的. Both 得 and 地 need a verb next to them, and 药单 is a noun.

items.q: 医生轻轻___按了按我的肚子。
items.zh: 医生轻轻地按了按我的肚子。
items.py: yī shēng qīng qīng de àn le àn wǒ de dù zi
items.en: The doctor gently pressed my stomach.
items.why: 轻轻 describes the manner of pressing and stands before the verb, so 地. Doubling does not change that.

items.s: 我喝了奶奶煮得姜汤。
items.s_py: wǒ hē le nǎi nai zhǔ de jiāng tāng
items.zh: 我喝了奶奶煮的姜汤。
items.py: wǒ hē le nǎi nai zhǔ de jiāng tāng
items.en: I drank the ginger soup Grandma cooked.
items.why: The clause 奶奶煮 describes the noun 姜汤, so the link is 的, not 得. 得 needs a judgement after it.

items.q: 天气太冷，手都冻红了，我拿___住笔。
items.zh: 天气太冷，手都冻红了，我拿不住笔。
items.py: tiān qì tài lěng shǒu dōu dòng hóng le wǒ ná bù zhù bǐ
items.en: It's so cold and my hands are so frozen red that I can't hold the pen.
items.why: The result of the cold is that I cannot hold the pen: 拿不住. 拿得住 would mean the opposite.

items.q: 妈妈把生病的孩子紧紧___抱在怀里。
items.zh: 妈妈把生病的孩子紧紧地抱在怀里。
items.py: mā ma bǎ shēng bìng de hái zi jǐn jǐn de bào zài huái lǐ
items.en: Mum held the sick child tightly in her arms.
items.why: 紧紧 is the manner of holding and precedes the verb 抱, so 地. 得 cannot come before the verb.

items.q: 病人的房间被护士打扫___干干净净。
items.zh: 病人的房间被护士打扫得干干净净。
items.py: bìng rén de fáng jiān bèi hù shi dǎ sǎo de gān gān jìng jìng
items.en: The patient's room was cleaned spotless by the nurse.
items.why: 打扫 + 得 + 干干净净 is a result complement, so 得. Doubling does not turn it into 地 or 的.

items.q: 外面冷___我不想出门。
items.zh: 外面冷得我不想出门。
items.py: wài miàn lěng de wǒ bù xiǎng chū mén
items.en: It's so cold outside that I don't want to go out.
items.why: 冷 + 得 + a clause with its own subject 我 gives the 'so cold that' pattern. 地 and 的 cannot introduce a result clause.

items.s: 医生写的字我看得不懂。
items.s_py: yī shēng xiě de zì wǒ kàn de bù dǒng
items.zh: 医生写的字我看不懂。
items.py: yī shēng xiě de zì wǒ kàn bù dǒng
items.en: I can't read the characters the doctor wrote.
items.why: 'Cannot' is 看不懂 (不 replaces 得). 看得不懂 mixes the two.

items.q: 药太苦了，我吃___下去。
items.zh: 药太苦了，我吃不下去。
items.py: yào tài kǔ le wǒ chī bù xià qù
items.en: The medicine is too bitter; I can't get it down.
items.why: 太苦 signals 'cannot', so the negative potential 吃不下去. 得 would say I can swallow it, contradicting 太苦.

items.q: 雨声太大，我听___见你说话。
items.zh: 雨声太大，我听不见你说话。
items.py: yǔ shēng tài dà wǒ tīng bù jiàn nǐ shuō huà
items.en: The rain is so loud I can't hear you.
items.why: The rain is too loud, so the meaning is 'cannot': 听不见. 得 would say you can hear, which the situation contradicts.

items.q: 护士写___很清楚，我一下子就看懂了。
items.zh: 护士写得很清楚，我一下子就看懂了。
items.py: hù shi xiě de hěn qīng chu wǒ yī xià zi jiù kàn dǒng le
items.en: The nurse wrote it very clearly, so I understood at a glance.
items.why: 清楚 judges how she wrote, so 写得很清楚. 的 would need a noun after it.

items.s: 他咳嗽得一晚上都没睡好。
items.zh: 他咳嗽得一晚上都没睡好。
items.py: tā ké sou de yī wǎn shang dōu méi shuì hǎo
items.en: He coughed so much that he didn't sleep well all night.
items.why: Verb + 得 + result clause is correct. 得 here introduces the result of the coughing, not a manner.

items.s: 听到自己的病好了，他高兴得哭了。
items.zh: 听到自己的病好了，他高兴得哭了。
items.py: tīng dào zì jǐ de bìng hǎo le tā gāo xìng de kū le
items.en: Hearing that he was cured, he was so happy he cried.
items.why: 高兴得哭了 is the extent pattern: so happy that he cried. The result 哭了 follows 得, which is correct.

items.q: 山上的雾很大，我们爬上去也看___到风景。
items.zh: 山上的雾很大，我们爬上去也看不到风景。
items.py: shān shàng de wù hěn dà wǒ men pá shàng qù yě kàn bù dào fēng jǐng
items.en: The fog on the mountain is thick; even if we climb up, we won't see the scenery.
items.why: Thick fog plus 也 (even if) leads to 'cannot see': 看不到. 看得到 would not fit after 雾很大.

items.q: 护士耐心___给孩子量体温。
items.zh: 护士耐心地给孩子量体温。
items.py: hù shi nài xīn de gěi hái zi liáng tǐ wēn
items.en: The nurse patiently took the child's temperature.
items.why: 耐心 describes how she did the task, so it takes 地 before the verb phrase. 得 would place the description after a verb.

items.q: 弟弟踢足球___不太好，因为膝盖受过伤。
items.zh: 弟弟踢足球踢得不太好，因为膝盖受过伤。
items.py: dì di tī zú qiú tī de bù tài hǎo yīn wèi xī gài shòu guo shāng
items.en: My younger brother doesn't play football very well because he once injured his knee.
items.why: 踢足球 has an object, so 踢 is repeated before 得, and the negative goes after it: 踢得不太好.

items.q: 这碗汤不多，你一个人喝___完。
items.zh: 这碗汤不多，你一个人喝得完。
items.py: zhè wǎn tāng bù duō nǐ yī gè rén hē de wán
items.en: This bowl of soup isn't much; you can finish it by yourself.
items.why: 不多 tells us it is manageable, so 'can': 喝得完. 喝不完 would be right for a huge amount of soup.

items.s: 我爷爷走路走得很慢。
items.zh: 我爷爷走路走得很慢。
items.py: wǒ yé ye zǒu lù zǒu de hěn màn
items.en: My grandpa walks very slowly.
items.why: 走路 has an object, so the verb is repeated before 得. This is the correct pattern, not a mistake.

items.q: 这几天雨下___不太多。
items.zh: 这几天雨下得不太多。
items.py: zhè jǐ tiān yǔ xià de bù tài duō
items.en: It hasn't rained much these last few days.
items.why: The negative goes after the particle: 下得不太多. 得 follows the verb 下 and introduces the judgement 不太多. 的 or 地 cannot introduce a degree comment.

items.zh: 护士轻轻地扶起了老人。
items.py: hù shi qīng qīng de fú qǐ le lǎo rén
items.en: The nurse gently helped the old man up.
items.why: 轻轻地 is a manner adverbial and goes right before the verb 扶起, after the subject. It cannot follow 扶起 or come after 了.

items.q: 今天天很晴，我们看___见月亮。
items.zh: 今天天很晴，我们看得见月亮。
items.py: jīn tiān tiān hěn qíng wǒ men kàn de jiàn yuè liang
items.en: It's very clear today, so we can see the moon.
items.why: A clear sky means 'can see', so verb + 得 + 见: 看得见. 不 would mean the moon is hidden, which a clear sky rules out.

items.q: 今年冬天来___很晚。
items.zh: 今年冬天来得很晚。
items.py: jīn nián dōng tiān lái de hěn wǎn
items.en: Winter came very late this year.
items.why: 来 + 得 + 很晚 judges the timing of the arrival. 地 belongs before a verb, and no noun follows for 的.

items.q: 北京冬天那种干燥又寒冷___空气让我的嗓子很不舒服。
items.zh: 北京冬天那种干燥又寒冷的空气让我的嗓子很不舒服。
items.py: běi jīng dōng tiān nà zhǒng gān zào yòu hán lěng de kōng qì ràng wǒ de sǎng zi hěn bù shū fu
items.en: The dry, freezing air of Beijing winters makes my throat very uncomfortable.
items.why: 干燥又寒冷 describes the noun 空气, so 的 is required. 地 would need the next word to be a verb, and 得 would need a comment after it.

items.s: 他忙地没有时间吃药。
items.s_py: tā máng de méi yǒu shí jiān chī yào
items.zh: 他忙得没有时间吃药。
items.py: tā máng de méi yǒu shí jiān chī yào
items.en: He is so busy that he has no time to take his medicine.
items.why: 忙 is a state, and 没有时间吃药 is the result, so 得. 地 would make 忙 a manner of an action.

items.zh: 奶奶打太极拳打得很好。
items.py: nǎi nai dǎ tài jí quán dǎ de hěn hǎo
items.en: Grandma does tai chi very well.
items.why: The verb 打 is repeated before 得 when there is an object. 打得 must follow 太极拳 and cannot come right after 奶奶.

items.zh: 妈妈煮的姜汤很热。
items.py: mā ma zhǔ de jiāng tāng hěn rè
items.en: The ginger soup Mum made is very hot.
items.why: The clause 妈妈煮 + 的 modifies the noun 姜汤, which is the subject of 很热.

items.s: 这是一个又热又湿的夏天。
items.zh: 这是一个又热又湿的夏天。
items.py: zhè shì yī gè yòu rè yòu shī de xià tiān
items.en: This is a hot and humid summer.
items.why: 又热又湿 describes the noun 夏天, so 的 is correct.

items.q: 夏天的太阳晒___我的皮肤又红又疼。
items.zh: 夏天的太阳晒得我的皮肤又红又疼。
items.py: xià tiān de tài yáng shài de wǒ de pí fū yòu hóng yòu téng
items.en: The summer sun burned my skin red and sore.
items.why: 晒 + 得 + result: the skin ended up red and sore. 地 would describe how the sun shines, which does not fit a result on the skin.

items.q: 今天风刮___很大。
items.zh: 今天风刮得很大。
items.py: jīn tiān fēng guā de hěn dà
items.en: The wind is blowing hard today.
items.why: 刮 is a verb and 很大 comments on how it blows, so 得. 的 would require a noun to follow.

items.s: 医生说的话你听得懂吗？
items.zh: 医生说的话你听得懂吗？
items.py: yī shēng shuō de huà nǐ tīng de dǒng ma
items.en: Can you understand what the doctor says?
items.why: 说的话 is clause + 的 + noun, and 听得懂 is the potential form. Both uses are correct.

items.s: 医生认真得检查了我的耳朵。
items.s_py: yī shēng rèn zhēn de jiǎn chá le wǒ de ěr duo
items.zh: 医生认真地检查了我的耳朵。
items.py: yī shēng rèn zhēn de jiǎn chá le wǒ de ěr duo
items.en: The doctor examined my ears carefully.
items.why: 认真 is the manner of the verb 检查 and stands before it, so 地. 得 only follows a verb or adjective.

items.q: 她小心___把热汤端到病人面前。
items.zh: 她小心地把热汤端到病人面前。
items.py: tā xiǎo xīn de bǎ rè tāng duān dào bìng rén miàn qián
items.en: She carefully carried the hot soup to the patient.
items.why: 小心 is the manner of the whole action 把汤端到病人面前, standing before the verb phrase, so 地.

items.s: 我不喜欢下雨的星期天。
items.zh: 我不喜欢下雨的星期天。
items.py: wǒ bù xǐ huan xià yǔ de xīng qī tiān
items.en: I don't like rainy Sundays.
items.why: A verb phrase before 的 is fine when a noun follows: 下雨的星期天. The sentence is correct because 的 joins a clause to the noun 星期天.

items.s: 药太多了，我不吃得完。
items.s_py: yào tài duō le wǒ bù chī de wán
items.zh: 药太多了，我吃不完。
items.py: yào tài duō le wǒ chī bù wán
items.en: There is too much medicine; I can't finish it.
items.why: The negative of 吃得完 replaces 得 with 不: 吃不完. 不 is not put before the verb.

items.q: 我妈妈睡觉___很早。
items.zh: 我妈妈睡觉睡得很早。
items.py: wǒ mā ma shuì jiào shuì de hěn zǎo
items.en: My mum goes to bed very early.
items.why: 睡觉 is verb + object, so repeat the verb before 得: 睡觉睡得很早. A bare 得 after 觉 is wrong.

items.q: 奶奶包___饺子很好吃。
items.zh: 奶奶包的饺子很好吃。
items.py: nǎi nai bāo de jiǎo zi hěn hǎo chī
items.en: The dumplings Grandma made are delicious.
items.why: After 包 comes the noun 饺子, so the clause 奶奶包 modifies it with 的. 得 would be followed by a judgement such as 很好, not by a noun.

items.q: 医生仔细___看了看我的喉咙，然后开了药。
items.zh: 医生仔细地看了看我的喉咙，然后开了药。
items.py: yī shēng zǐ xì de kàn le kàn wǒ de hóu lóng rán hòu kāi le yào
items.en: The doctor looked carefully at my throat and then prescribed medicine.
items.why: 仔细 is the manner of 看, so 地 goes before the verb. 得 would require 看 before the particle.

items.q: 太阳慢慢___升起来了。
items.zh: 太阳慢慢地升起来了。
items.py: tài yáng màn màn de shēng qǐ lái le
items.en: The sun slowly rose.
items.why: Doubled adjective before a verb: 慢慢地升. 得 would need the verb first, as in 升得很慢.

items.q: 我最怕下大雨___晚上一个人回家。
items.zh: 我最怕下大雨的晚上一个人回家。
items.py: wǒ zuì pà xià dà yǔ de wǎn shang yī gè rén huí jiā
items.en: I'm most afraid of going home alone on nights when it pours.
items.why: 下大雨 modifies the noun 晚上, so 的. The word after the gap is a noun, which cannot take 地 or 得.

items.q: 这个城市春天___天气最舒服。
items.zh: 这个城市春天的天气最舒服。
items.py: zhè gè chéng shì chūn tiān de tiān qì zuì shū fu
items.en: The weather in spring is the most comfortable in this city.
items.why: 春天 owns the noun 天气 (spring's weather), so 的 joins them. 地 or 得 would need a verb on one side.

items.q: 昨天的台风刮___很多树都倒了。
items.zh: 昨天的台风刮得很多树都倒了。
items.py: zuó tiān de tái fēng guā de hěn duō shù dōu dǎo le
items.en: Yesterday's typhoon blew so hard that many trees fell.
items.why: 刮 + 得 + result clause with its own subject 很多树. Reading 的 as a noun link fails because 很多树都倒了 is a full clause.

items.q: 她是一位很仔细___医生。
items.zh: 她是一位很仔细的医生。
items.py: tā shì yī wèi hěn zǐ xì de yī shēng
items.en: She is a very careful doctor.
items.why: 仔细 describes the noun 医生, so 的. 地 would be for a verb, which does not follow here.

items.q: 我喜欢下雪___日子。
items.zh: 我喜欢下雪的日子。
items.py: wǒ xǐ huan xià xuě de rì zi
items.en: I like days when it snows.
items.why: 下雪 is a clause that describes the noun 日子 (days on which it snows), so 的. 得 and 地 do not link a clause to a noun.

items.s: 她轻轻地摸了摸孩子发烫的额头。
items.zh: 她轻轻地摸了摸孩子发烫的额头。
items.py: tā qīng qīng de mō le mō hái zi fā tàng de é tóu
items.en: She gently touched the child's burning forehead.
items.why: 轻轻地 precedes the verb 摸, and 发烫的 describes the noun 额头, so both particles are correct.

items.q: 这家医院的医生很多，今天下午你一定挂___到号。
items.zh: 这家医院的医生很多，今天下午你一定挂得到号。
items.py: zhè jiā yī yuàn de yī shēng hěn duō jīn tiān xià wǔ nǐ yī dìng guà de dào hào
items.en: This hospital has many doctors, so you will surely get a number this afternoon.
items.why: Many doctors and 一定 point to 'can': 挂得到号. 挂不到号 contradicts the optimistic context.

items.q: 这是医生昨天给我开___药，一天吃三次。
items.zh: 这是医生昨天给我开的药，一天吃三次。
items.py: zhè shì yī shēng zuó tiān gěi wǒ kāi de yào yī tiān chī sān cì
items.en: This is the medicine the doctor prescribed for me yesterday; I take it three times a day.
items.why: The whole clause 医生昨天给我开 describes the noun 药, so 的. Because a noun follows, 得 (which expects a judgement) is wrong.

items.q: 医生很清楚___告诉我，这种药一天只能吃两次。
items.zh: 医生很清楚地告诉我，这种药一天只能吃两次。
items.py: yī shēng hěn qīng chu de gào su wǒ zhè zhǒng yào yī tiān zhǐ néng chī liǎng cì
items.en: The doctor told me clearly that this medicine can only be taken twice a day.
items.why: 很清楚 sits before the verb 告诉 as its manner, so 地. After a verb the same word would take 得.

items.q: 昨天下午来看病___人很多。
items.zh: 昨天下午来看病的人很多。
items.py: zuó tiān xià wǔ lái kàn bìng de rén hěn duō
items.en: Lots of people came to see a doctor yesterday afternoon.
items.why: 来看病 describes the noun 人, so 的. 得 would need a complement like 很快 right after it, but a noun follows.

items.q: 这是奶奶给我买___帽子。
items.zh: 这是奶奶给我买的帽子。
items.py: zhè shì nǎi nai gěi wǒ mǎi de mào zi
items.en: This is the hat Grandma bought for me.
items.why: The clause 奶奶给我买 describes the noun 帽子, so 的 joins them even though a verb stands before the gap. 得 would need a result or judgement after it.

items.s: 她游泳得很好。
items.s_py: tā yóu yǒng de hěn hǎo
items.zh: 她游泳游得很好。
items.py: tā yóu yǒng yóu de hěn hǎo
items.en: She swims very well.
items.why: 得 must follow the verb, not the object. With 游泳 the verb 游 is repeated before 得.

items.q: 她安静___坐在床边。
items.zh: 她安静地坐在床边。
items.py: tā ān jìng de zuò zài chuáng biān
items.en: She sat quietly beside the bed.
items.why: 安静 describes how she sat, and a verb follows, so 地. 得 does not go before a verb, and 着 is not a linker.

items.q: 奶奶最近走___不太稳，我们要小心。
items.zh: 奶奶最近走得不太稳，我们要小心。
items.py: nǎi nai zuì jìn zǒu de bù tài wěn wǒ men yào xiǎo xīn
items.en: Grandma hasn't been walking very steadily lately, so we have to be careful.
items.why: 走 + 得 + 不太稳 judges how she walks. 的 would need a noun, 地 a verb after it, and 稳 is an adjective.

items.q: 医生写的字太小了，我看___清楚。
items.zh: 医生写的字太小了，我看不清楚。
items.py: yī shēng xiě de zì tài xiǎo le wǒ kàn bù qīng chu
items.en: The characters the doctor wrote are too small; I can't read them clearly.
items.why: Too small means I cannot manage it: 看不清楚. 看得清楚 would say I can see clearly, the opposite of 太小.

items.s: 这是爸爸买得足球。
items.s_py: zhè shì bà bà mǎi de zú qiú
items.zh: 这是爸爸买的足球。
items.py: zhè shì bà bà mǎi de zú qiú
items.en: This is the football Dad bought.
items.why: 买 + 足球 is a clause describing a noun, so 的. 得 would need a judgement or result after it, not a noun.

items.s: 这是我哥哥买的球鞋。
items.s_py: zhè shì wǒ gē gē mǎi de qiú xié
items.zh: 这是我哥哥买的球鞋。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ gē gē mǎi de qiú xié
items.en: These are the sneakers my older brother bought.
items.why: 买 is followed by 的 because the noun 球鞋 follows. The verb before the de does not force 得.

items.s: 在公园里打太极拳得那些老人每天早上六点就到了。
items.s_py: zài gōng yuán lǐ dǎ tài jí quán de nà xiē lǎo rén měi tiān zǎo shàng liù diǎn jiù dào le
items.zh: 在公园里打太极拳的那些老人每天早上六点就到了。
items.py: zài gōng yuán lǐ dǎ tài jí quán de nà xiē lǎo rén měi tiān zǎo shàng liù diǎn jiù dào le
items.en: The old people who do tai chi in the park are there every morning at six.
items.why: The clause 在公园里打太极拳 describes the noun phrase 那些老人, so 的. 得 would need to follow a verb and be followed by a judgement.

items.q: 你们走___太慢了，我们要迟到了。
items.zh: 你们走得太慢了，我们要迟到了。
items.py: nǐ men zǒu de tài màn le wǒ men yào chí dào le
items.en: You walk too slowly, we are going to be late.
items.why: 走 is the verb and 太慢了 is the judgement, so 得 sits between them. 的 would need a noun after it.

items.q: 地铁站在那个很大___公园旁边。
items.zh: 地铁站在那个很大的公园旁边。
items.py: dì tiě zhàn zài nà ge hěn dà de gōng yuán páng biān
items.en: The metro station is next to that very big park.
items.why: 很大 describes the noun 公园, so the link is 的. 地 would need a verb right after it, and 得 needs a verb or adjective before it as its base.

items.q: 站在这儿就能看___见前面的体育馆。
items.zh: 站在这儿就能看得见前面的体育馆。
items.py: zhàn zài zhè r jiù néng kàn de jiàn qián miàn de tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: From here you can see the gymnasium ahead.
items.why: Verb + 得 + result word means 'can': 看得见. 不 would say you cannot see it, contradicting 能. 的 would need a noun after it.

items.q: 我弟弟踢足球___比我好多了。
items.zh: 我弟弟踢足球踢得比我好多了。
items.py: wǒ dì di tī zú qiú tī de bǐ wǒ hǎo duō le
items.en: My younger brother plays football much better than I do.
items.why: The object 足球 sits after 踢, so 踢 is said again and 得 follows it. A bare 得 after the object is not possible.

items.s: 小李开车得很稳。
items.s_py: xiǎo lǐ kāi chē de hěn wěn
items.zh: 小李开车开得很稳。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ kāi chē kāi de hěn wěn
items.en: Xiao Li drives very steadily.
items.why: 得 attached to the object 车 is wrong. The verb is repeated: 开车开得很稳.

items.q: 他很流利___回答了裁判的问题。
items.zh: 他很流利地回答了裁判的问题。
items.py: tā hěn liú lì de huí dá le cái pàn de wèn tí
items.en: He answered the referee's questions very fluently.
items.why: 很流利 describes how he answered, and 回答 follows, so 地. 得 would need 回答 to come first.

items.q: 昨天的足球赛，他们踢___不好，输了比赛。
items.zh: 昨天的足球赛，他们踢得不好，输了比赛。
items.py: zuó tiān de zú qiú sài tā men tī de bù hǎo shū le bǐ sài
items.en: In yesterday's football match they played badly and lost.
items.why: 踢得不好 negates the judgement, not the verb: 不 goes after 得. 的 would need a noun after it, and 地 a verb.

items.s: 我昨天跑得很累，今天腿疼得走不了路。
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān pǎo de tài lèi jīn tiān tuǐ téng de zǒu bù liǎo lù
items.zh: 我昨天跑得很累，今天腿疼得走不了路。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān pǎo de hěn lèi jīn tiān tuǐ téng de zǒu bù liǎo lù
items.en: I got very tired from running yesterday, and today my legs hurt so much that I can't walk.
items.why: 跑得很累 is a judgement of the running and 疼得走不了路 is a 'so ... that' result, so both are 得. Correct.

items.q: 我昨天买___球鞋很贵。
items.zh: 我昨天买的球鞋很贵。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de qiú xié hěn guì
items.en: The sneakers I bought yesterday were expensive.
items.why: The gap follows the verb 买, which tempts 得, but the noun 球鞋 comes right after it. A clause that describes a noun is joined with 的.

items.q: 我看___懂这个字，你能教我吗？
items.zh: 我看不懂这个字，你能教我吗？
items.py: wǒ kàn bù dǒng zhè ge zì nǐ néng jiào wǒ ma
items.en: I can't read this character; can you teach me?
items.why: The cue and the request for help mean 'cannot', so 得 is swapped for 不: 看不懂. 看得懂 would mean the opposite.

items.s: 他们高高兴兴地去爬山了。
items.s_py: tā men gāo gāo xìng xìng de qù pá shān le
items.zh: 他们高高兴兴地去爬山了。
items.py: tā men gāo gāo xìng xìng de qù pá shān le
items.en: They went off climbing in high spirits.
items.why: The doubled adjective in front of the verb 去 takes 地, so the sentence is correct.

items.s: 裁判认真得看了一遍录像，然后改了决定。
items.s_py: cái pàn rèn zhēn de kàn le yī biàn lù xiàng rán hòu gǎi le jué dìng
items.zh: 裁判认真地看了一遍录像，然后改了决定。
items.py: cái pàn rèn zhēn de kàn le yī biàn lù xiàng rán hòu gǎi le jué dìng
items.en: The referee watched the replay carefully and then changed the decision.
items.why: 认真 describes the manner of the verb 看, so it takes 地. 得 cannot sit before a verb of the action.

items.s: 我们慢慢得走回家。
items.s_py: wǒ men màn màn de zǒu huí jiā
items.zh: 我们慢慢地走回家。
items.py: wǒ men màn màn de zǒu huí jiā
items.en: We walked slowly home.
items.why: 慢慢 describes the manner of 走, so it needs 地 before the verb. 得 only follows a verb or adjective.

items.s: 路上的车太多，我们开得很慢。
items.s_py: lù shàng de chē tài duō wǒ men kāi de hěn màn
items.zh: 路上的车太多，我们开得很慢。
items.py: lù shàng de chē tài duō wǒ men kāi de hěn màn
items.en: There was too much traffic on the road, so we drove very slowly.
items.why: 开 + 得 + 很慢 judges how we drove, with no object, so no repeated verb is needed. Correct.

items.q: 请你清楚___告诉我地铁站怎么走。
items.zh: 请你清楚地告诉我地铁站怎么走。
items.py: qǐng nǐ qīng chǔ de gào sù wǒ dì tiě zhàn zěn me zǒu
items.en: Please tell me clearly how to get to the metro station.
items.why: 清楚 is the manner of the verb 告诉, so 地. 得 needs a verb on its left, and 请你 cannot take it.

items.zh: 他游泳游得很快。
items.py: tā yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài
items.en: He swims fast.
items.why: 得 follows the repeated verb 游, not the object 游泳. The object can also be fronted as a topic.

items.s: 他说话太快，我不听得懂。
items.s_py: tā shuō huà tài kuài wǒ bù tīng de dǒng
items.zh: 他说话太快，我听不懂。
items.py: tā shuō huà tài kuài wǒ tīng bù dǒng
items.en: He speaks too fast, and I cannot understand.
items.why: To say 'cannot', 得 becomes 不: 听不懂. A 不 in front of 听得懂 is a classic mistake that natives do not make.

items.s: 这是一个很大地公园。
items.s_py: zhè shì yí gè hěn dà de gōng yuán
items.zh: 这是一个很大的公园。
items.py: zhè shì yī gè hěn dà de gōng yuán
items.en: This is a very big park.
items.why: The noun 公园 follows, so a describing word takes 的. 地 is only for linking to a verb.

items.q: 他是我们队里最高___球员。
items.zh: 他是我们队里最高的球员。
items.py: tā shì wǒ men duì lǐ zuì gāo de qiú yuán
items.en: He is the tallest player on our team.
items.why: 最高 describes the noun 球员, so 的 is the link. 地 would be wrong because no verb follows.

items.s: 我不看得懂这个路牌。
items.s_py: wǒ bù kàn de dǒng zhè ge lù pái
items.zh: 我看不懂这个路牌。
items.py: wǒ kàn bù dǒng zhè ge lù pái
items.en: I can't understand this road sign.
items.why: The 'cannot' form swaps 得 for 不 inside the verb: 看不懂. Putting 不 before the verb and keeping 得 is not Chinese.

items.q: 前面那条路___名字叫中山路。
items.zh: 前面那条路的名字叫中山路。
items.py: qián miàn nà tiáo lù de míng zì jiào zhōng shān lù
items.en: The name of the road ahead is Zhongshan Road.
items.why: 路 and 名字 are both nouns and the road owns the name, so 的 links them. 地 and 得 never sit between two nouns.

items.s: 弟弟不跑得快。
items.s_py: dì di bù pǎo de kuài
items.zh: 弟弟跑得不快。
items.py: dì di pǎo de bù kuài
items.en: My younger brother doesn't run fast.
items.why: With 得, the negative goes on the judgement: 跑得不快. 不 before the verb is not possible in this pattern.

items.q: 他是一个很努力___运动员。
items.zh: 他是一个很努力的运动员。
items.py: tā shì yī gè hěn nǔ lì de yùn dòng yuán
items.en: He is a very hardworking athlete.
items.why: 努力 sits before the noun 运动员, so 的. The same word before a verb would take 地 and after a verb 得.

items.q: 我们安安静静___坐在球场边，看着他们比赛。
items.zh: 我们安安静静地坐在球场边，看着他们比赛。
items.py: wǒ men ān ān jìng jìng de zuò zài qiú chǎng biān kàn zhe tā men bǐ sài
items.en: We sat quietly at the edge of the pitch, watching them play.
items.why: 安安静静 gives the manner of 坐, so 地 sits between them. 得 would need 坐 before it.

items.q: 她今天来___很早。
items.zh: 她今天来得很早。
items.py: tā jīn tiān lái de hěn zǎo
items.en: She came very early today.
items.why: 来 + 得 + 很早 judges how early she came. 地 would need a verb after it, and 的 a noun.

items.q: 他练球练___很努力，所以进步很快。
items.zh: 他练球练得很努力，所以进步很快。
items.py: tā liàn qiú liàn de hěn nǔ lì suǒ yǐ jìn bù hěn kuài
items.en: He trains very hard, so he improves quickly.
items.why: 练 is repeated before 得, and 很努力 judges how he trains. 地 would belong before the verb, not after it.

items.s: 你看得见那个路牌吗？
items.s_py: nǐ kàn de jiàn nà ge lù pái ma
items.zh: 你看得见那个路牌吗？
items.py: nǐ kàn de jiàn nà ge lù pái ma
items.en: Can you see that road sign?
items.why: 看得见 is the positive 'can see' form, and the question is formed with 吗. Correct.

items.q: 他的字写___工工整整。
items.zh: 他的字写得工工整整。
items.py: tā de zì xiě de gōng gōng zhěng zhěng
items.en: His characters are written very neatly.
items.why: 写 is the verb and 工工整整 describes the result, so 得 follows 写 even though the adjective is doubled. 地 is for before a verb.

items.q: 队员们互相鼓励，努力___爬到了山顶。
items.zh: 队员们互相鼓励，努力地爬到了山顶。
items.py: duì yuán men hù xiāng gǔ lì nǔ lì de pá dào le shān dǐng
items.en: The team members encouraged one another and climbed to the summit with great effort.
items.why: 努力 is the manner of the verb 爬到, so 地 comes before it. 得 would follow a verb, and there is none before 努力.

items.q: 我们高高兴兴___骑车去了公园。
items.zh: 我们高高兴兴地骑车去了公园。
items.py: wǒ men gāo gāo xìng xìng de qí chē qù le gōng yuán
items.en: We cheerfully rode our bikes to the park.
items.why: 高高兴兴 is a doubled description of how we rode, in front of the verb 骑, so 地. 得 would need a verb before it.

items.s: 她游泳游得比我快多了。
items.s_py: tā yóu yǒng yóu de bǐ wǒ kuài duō le
items.zh: 她游泳游得比我快多了。
items.py: tā yóu yǒng yóu de bǐ wǒ kuài duō le
items.en: She swims much faster than I do.
items.why: The verb 游 is repeated after 游泳 and 得 follows it. A 比 phrase can sit inside the judgement.

items.q: 我们昨天晚上在街角吃___那家面馆下个月要搬走了。
items.zh: 我们昨天晚上在街角吃的那家面馆下个月要搬走了。
items.py: wǒ men zuó tiān wǎn shàng zài jiē jiǎo chī de nà jiā miàn guǎn xià gè yuè yào bān zǒu le
items.en: The noodle shop on the corner where we ate last night will move away next month.
items.why: 吃 is followed by the noun phrase 那家面馆, which the whole clause describes. 得 after 吃 would need a judgement such as 很饱 directly after it.

items.s: 足球他踢得很好。
items.s_py: zú qiú tā tī de hěn hǎo
items.zh: 足球他踢得很好。
items.py: zú qiú tā tī de hěn hǎo
items.en: He plays football very well.
items.why: The object 足球 is moved to the front as the topic, so 踢 needs no repeating and 得 follows it directly. This is fully correct.

items.q: 弟弟在公园拍___那张照片很漂亮。
items.zh: 弟弟在公园拍的那张照片很漂亮。
items.py: dì di zài gōng yuán pāi de nà zhāng zhào piān hěn piào liàng
items.en: The photo my younger brother took in the park is beautiful.
items.why: 拍 is a verb, but the next word begins the noun phrase 那张照片. Verb + 的 + noun marks 'the photo that was taken', not 拍得 + judgement.

items.q: 这是爸爸开___车。
items.zh: 这是爸爸开的车。
items.py: zhè shì bà bà kāi de chē
items.en: This is the car Dad drives.
items.why: 开 is a verb, but 车 is the noun it describes: 爸爸开的车 means 'the car Dad drives'. 得 would need a judgement like 很快 after it.

items.q: 这么多菜，我们三个人肯定吃___完。
items.zh: 这么多菜，我们三个人肯定吃不完。
items.py: zhè me duō cài wǒ men sān gè rén kěn dìng chī bù wán
items.en: With this much food, the three of us definitely cannot finish it.
items.why: 吃 + result word 完, and 肯定 with 这么多菜 means 'cannot'. 不 replaces 得. 吃得完 would claim we can.

items.q: 孩子轻轻___把门关上了。
items.zh: 孩子轻轻地把门关上了。
items.py: hái zi qīng qīng de bǎ mén guān shàng le
items.en: The child closed the door gently.
items.why: 轻轻 describes how the door was closed and the verb phrase follows, so 地. 得 needs a verb on its left.

items.zh: 我们认真地看地图。
items.py: wǒ men rèn zhēn de kàn dì tú
items.en: We looked at the map carefully.
items.why: 认真 + 地 sits before the verb 看 and cannot follow it. The judgement pattern would be 看得很认真.

items.s: 今天风大地让我们没法骑车。
items.s_py: jīn tiān fēng dà de ràng wǒ men méi fǎ qí chē
items.zh: 今天风大得让我们没法骑车。
items.py: jīn tiān fēng dà de ràng wǒ men méi fǎ qí chē
items.en: The wind is so strong today that we can't ride our bikes.
items.why: 风大 is a state and 让我们没法骑车 is its result, so it is 得. 地 would need a verb of manner to follow.

items.q: 虽然他刚学滑冰，但是滑___已经很稳了。
items.zh: 虽然他刚学滑冰，但是滑得已经很稳了。
items.py: suī rán tā gāng xué huá bīng dàn shì huá de yǐ jīng hěn wěn le
items.en: Although he has only just learned to skate, he already skates quite steadily.
items.why: 滑 is the verb and 已经很稳了 is the judgement of how he skates, so 得. 地 would put a manner before a verb, not after one.

items.q: 我们在体育馆看___那场比赛很精彩。
items.zh: 我们在体育馆看的那场比赛很精彩。
items.py: wǒ men zài tǐ yù guǎn kàn de nà chǎng bǐ sài hěn jīng cǎi
items.en: The match we watched at the gymnasium was exciting.
items.why: After 看 comes the noun phrase 那场比赛, so the clause 我们在体育馆看 is describing it and needs 的. 得 would need an adjective or result after it.

items.q: 冬天的风冷___让人睁不开眼睛。
items.zh: 冬天的风冷得让人睁不开眼睛。
items.py: dōng tiān de fēng lěng de ràng rén zhēng bù kāi yǎn jīng
items.en: The winter wind is so cold that you can't open your eyes.
items.why: 冷 + 得 + 让人睁不开眼睛 is 'so cold that ...'. 的 would need a noun, and 地 a verb, but a result clause follows.

items.q: 票已经卖完了，我们肯定买___到了。
items.zh: 票已经卖完了，我们肯定买不到了。
items.py: piào yǐ jīng mài wán le wǒ men kěn dìng mǎi bù dào le
items.en: The tickets are sold out, so we definitely cannot get any now.
items.why: 卖完了 means none are left, so we 'cannot' buy: 买不到. 得 would claim success, which the first clause rules out.

items.q: 司机耐心___等着乘客上车。
items.zh: 司机耐心地等着乘客上车。
items.py: sī jī nài xīn de děng zhe chéng kè shàng chē
items.en: The driver patiently waited for the passengers to get on.
items.why: 耐心 is the manner of the action 等着, so 耐心 + 地 + verb. 得 would turn the verb 等着 into the base of a judgement, which is not what the order says.

items.q: 站在山顶上，我们看___到整个城市，真漂亮！
items.zh: 站在山顶上，我们看得到整个城市，真漂亮！
items.py: zhàn zài shān dǐng shàng wǒ men kàn de dào zhěng gè chéng shì zhēn piào liang
items.en: Standing on the summit, we can see the whole city, it's beautiful!
items.why: Verb + 得 + 到 means 'can see'; the delight in 真漂亮 shows the view is open to us. 看不到 would say the opposite, and 的 would need a noun after it.

items.q: 他跑___很快。
items.zh: 他跑得很快。
items.py: tā pǎo de hěn kuài
items.en: He runs fast.
items.why: 跑 is a verb and 很快 judges how he runs, so 得 goes between them. 的 needs a noun after it and 地 needs a verb after it.

items.q: 这是我哥哥___足球。
items.zh: 这是我哥哥的足球。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ gē gē de zú qiú
items.en: This is my older brother's football.
items.why: 哥哥 is the owner and 足球 is a noun, so 的 joins them. 得 follows a verb or adjective and 地 sits before a verb; neither can link an owner to a noun.

items.s: 他很快地跑到球场中间，把球传给了队友。
items.s_py: tā hěn kuài de pǎo dào qiú chǎng zhōng jiān bǎ qiú chuán gěi le duì yǒu
items.zh: 他很快地跑到球场中间，把球传给了队友。
items.py: tā hěn kuài de pǎo dào qiú chǎng zhōng jiān bǎ qiú chuán gěi le duì yǒu
items.en: He quickly ran to the middle of the pitch and passed the ball to his teammate.
items.why: 很快 describes the manner of the verb 跑到, so 地 before the verb is correct, even though 跑得很快 is the other common pattern.

items.q: 她很小心___把球放在桌子上。
items.zh: 她很小心地把球放在桌子上。
items.py: tā hěn xiǎo xīn de bǎ qiú fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: She very carefully put the ball on the table.
items.why: The describing phrase 很小心 comes before the verb phrase 把球放在桌子上, so 地 joins them.

items.s: 她很好地踢足球，大家都喜欢看她的比赛。
items.s_py: tā hěn hǎo de tī zú qiú dà jiā dōu xǐ huān kàn tā de bǐ sài
items.zh: 她踢足球踢得很好，大家都喜欢看她的比赛。
items.py: tā tī zú qiú tī de hěn hǎo dà jiā dōu xǐ huān kàn tā de bǐ sài
items.en: She plays football well, and everybody likes to watch her matches.
items.why: English 'well' judges how she plays, so Chinese puts it after the verb with 得 and repeats the verb. 很好地踢 is not said.

items.q: 观众们整齐___站起来，为获胜的队员鼓掌。
items.zh: 观众们整齐地站起来，为获胜的队员鼓掌。
items.py: guān zhòng men zhěng qí de zhàn qǐ lái wèi huò shèng de duì yuán gǔ zhǎng
items.en: The spectators stood up in unison to applaud the winning players.
items.why: 整齐 describes how they stood up and a verb follows, so 地. 得 would need 整齐 to be the base of a result.

items.q: 他们热情___告诉我怎么去火车站。
items.zh: 他们热情地告诉我怎么去火车站。
items.py: tā men rè qíng de gào sù wǒ zěn me qù huǒ chē zhàn
items.en: They enthusiastically told me how to get to the train station.
items.why: 热情 describes how they told me, and 告诉 is a verb, so 地. 得 would need 告诉 on its left instead.

items.q: 这个城市有很多干净___街道。
items.zh: 这个城市有很多干净的街道。
items.py: zhè ge chéng shì yǒu hěn duō gān jìng de jiē dào
items.en: This city has many clean streets.
items.why: 干净 describes 街道, a noun, so 的. 得 would need a verb before it and a judgement after it, which this phrase does not have.

items.q: 每天早上在河边打太极拳___老人们，都住在这个小区。
items.zh: 每天早上在河边打太极拳的老人们，都住在这个小区。
items.py: měi tiān zǎo shàng zài hé biān dǎ tài jí quán de lǎo rén men dōu zhù zài zhè ge xiǎo qū
items.en: The old people who do tai chi by the river every morning all live in this neighbourhood.
items.why: The long clause describes the noun 老人们, so 的 closes it. 打太极拳 is verb + object, and 得 could not attach after the object anyway.

items.zh: 外面冷得我们都不想出门。
items.py: wài miàn lěng de wǒ men dōu bù xiǎng chū mén
items.en: It is so cold outside that none of us wants to go out.
items.why: 冷 + 得 + a result clause with its own subject 我们. 得 comes right after 冷.

items.q: 骑自行车去上班___人越来越多了。
items.zh: 骑自行车去上班的人越来越多了。
items.py: qí zì xíng chē qù shàng bān de rén yuè lái yuè duō le
items.en: More and more people ride bikes to work.
items.why: 骑自行车去上班 describes the noun 人, so the clause takes 的. 地 would require a verb to follow, but 人 is a noun.

items.s: 穿蓝衣服得那个人是我们的教练。
items.s_py: chuān lán yī fú de nà ge rén shì wǒ men de jiào liàn
items.zh: 穿蓝衣服的那个人是我们的教练。
items.py: chuān lán yī fú de nà ge rén shì wǒ men de jiào liàn
items.en: The person wearing blue is our coach.
items.why: 穿蓝衣服 describes the person 那个人, so the joint is 的. 得 never joins a clause to a noun phrase.

items.q: 地铁里人多___我们都挤不上去。
items.zh: 地铁里人多得我们都挤不上去。
items.py: dì tiě lǐ rén duō de wǒ men dōu jǐ bù shàng qù
items.en: The metro was so crowded that we could not squeeze on.
items.why: 人多 states a condition, and 我们都挤不上去 is the result. Adjective + 得 + result clause, so 得.

items.q: 他每天都努力___练习游泳。
items.zh: 他每天都努力地练习游泳。
items.py: tā měi tiān dōu nǔ lì de liàn xí yóu yǒng
items.en: He practises swimming hard every day.
items.why: 努力 now comes before the verb 练习, so 地. 得 would need 努力 to be a verb or adjective that the next words comment on.

items.q: 她认真___看地图。
items.zh: 她认真地看地图。
items.py: tā rèn zhēn de kàn dì tú
items.en: She looks at the map carefully.
items.why: 认真 describes the manner of the verb 看, so 地 sits before it. 得 follows a verb and would need 看 on the left of the gap.

items.q: 地图太小了，我们看___清楚路。
items.zh: 地图太小了，我们看不清楚路。
items.py: dì tú tài xiǎo le wǒ men kàn bù qīng chǔ lù
items.en: The map is too small; we can't see the road clearly.
items.why: The map is too small, so the result is 'cannot'. 看不清楚 replaces 得 with 不; 看得清楚 would say we can.

items.zh: 我喜欢小王拍的照片。
items.py: wǒ xǐ huān xiǎo wáng pāi de zhào piān
items.en: I like the photos Xiao Wang took.
items.why: The clause 小王拍 describes the noun 照片, so 的 comes after 拍 and before 照片.

items.q: 他说得太快了，我一句都听___懂。
items.zh: 他说得太快了，我一句都听不懂。
items.py: tā shuō de tài kuài le wǒ yī jù dōu tīng bù dǒng
items.en: He spoke too fast and I couldn't understand a single sentence.
items.why: 一句都 is a negative-sense phrase, so the form must be the 'cannot' one: 听不懂. 听得懂 would assert that I understood.

items.s: 今天热得我不想去公园。
items.s_py: jīn tiān rè de wǒ bù xiǎng qù gōng yuán
items.zh: 今天热得我不想去公园。
items.py: jīn tiān rè de wǒ bù xiǎng qù gōng yuán
items.en: It's so hot today that I don't want to go to the park.
items.why: 热 + 得 + a clause with its own subject 我 is the 'so ... that' pattern. Correct as it stands.

items.q: 小王开车___很小心。
items.zh: 小王开车开得很小心。
items.py: xiǎo wáng kāi chē kāi de hěn xiǎo xīn
items.en: Xiao Wang drives very carefully.
items.why: 开车 is verb + object, so the verb 开 is repeated before 得. Putting 得 after 车 is the classic mistake.

items.q: 你说___对。
items.zh: 你说得对。
items.py: nǐ shuō de duì
items.en: You're right.
items.why: 说 is the verb and 对 is the judgement of what was said, so 得. 地 would need a verb after it, and 对 is an adjective.

items.q: 今天的比赛打___很精彩。
items.zh: 今天的比赛打得很精彩。
items.py: jīn tiān de bǐ sài dǎ de hěn jīng cǎi
items.en: Today's match was played very excitingly.
items.why: 打 is the verb and 很精彩 is the comment on how the match was played, so 得. Nothing noun-like follows, so 的 is out.

items.q: 这条街上的车多___我们等了十分钟才过了马路。
items.zh: 这条街上的车多得我们等了十分钟才过了马路。
items.py: zhè tiáo jiē shàng de chē duō de wǒ men děng le shí fēn zhōng cái guò le mǎ lù
items.en: There was so much traffic on this street that we waited ten minutes before we could cross.
items.why: 车多 is a state, and the result is that we had to wait ten minutes. 'So ... that ...' takes 得. 地 would need a verb of manner to follow.

items.s: 他认真得听教练说话。
items.s_py: tā rèn zhēn de tīng jiào liàn shuō huà
items.zh: 他认真地听教练说话。
items.py: tā rèn zhēn de tīng jiào liàn shuō huà
items.en: He listens carefully to the coach.
items.why: 认真 is the manner of 听, a verb that follows, so 地. 得 cannot come before a verb.

items.q: 他买了一双很舒服___运动鞋。
items.zh: 他买了一双很舒服的运动鞋。
items.py: tā mǎi le yī shuāng hěn shū fú de yùn dòng xié
items.en: He bought a pair of very comfortable sports shoes.
items.why: 很舒服 modifies the noun 运动鞋, so 的 is required. 地 would only fit if a verb came next, as in 舒服地坐着.

items.q: 这家店的蛋糕卖___很快，下午三点就没有了。
items.zh: 这家店的蛋糕卖得很快，下午三点就没有了。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de dàn gāo mài de hěn kuài xià wǔ sān diǎn jiù méi yǒu le
items.en: The cakes at this shop sell very fast; by three in the afternoon they are gone.
items.why: 卖 is the verb and 很快 judges how it sells, so 得. 的 would need a noun, and 地 a verb after the gap.

items.q: 他练球练___连饭都忘了吃。
items.zh: 他练球练得连饭都忘了吃。
items.py: tā liàn qiú liàn de lián fàn dōu wàng le chī
items.en: He practised so hard that he even forgot to eat.
items.why: 练球 repeats the verb 练, and 得 follows the second 练. What comes next is the result (连饭都忘了吃), so 得.

items.zh: 她今天跑得很慢。
items.py: tā jīn tiān pǎo de hěn màn
items.en: She ran very slowly today.
items.why: 得 sits between the verb 跑 and the judgement 很慢. The time word 今天 can come before or after 她.

items.q: 他昨天踢___特别好，进了两个球。
items.zh: 他昨天踢得特别好，进了两个球。
items.py: tā zuó tiān tī de tè bié hǎo jìn le liǎng gè qiú
items.en: He played especially well yesterday and scored two goals.
items.why: 踢 + 得 + 特别好 judges his play, and the 进了两个球 clause confirms it. 地 would put the quality before the verb as a manner, which does not fit a judgement.

items.q: 他打篮球___很好。
items.zh: 他打篮球打得很好。
items.py: tā dǎ lán qiú dǎ de hěn hǎo
items.en: He plays basketball very well.
items.why: 得 must follow a verb directly. With the object 篮球 already after 打, the verb is repeated: 打篮球打得很好. 打篮球得 attaches 得 to the object.

items.q: 这种篮球在附近的商店买___到。
items.zh: 这种篮球在附近的商店买得到。
items.py: zhè zhǒng lán qiú zài fù jìn de shāng diàn mǎi de dào
items.en: You can buy this kind of basketball at the shops nearby.
items.why: 买得到 is verb + 得 + result: 'can be bought'. 不 would reverse the meaning. 地 would need a verb after it.

items.q: 这是一个很清楚___路线图，一看就明白。
items.zh: 这是一个很清楚的路线图，一看就明白。
items.py: zhè shì yī gè hěn qīng chǔ de lù xiàn tú yī kàn jiù míng bái
items.en: This is a very clear route map; you understand it at a glance.
items.why: 路线图 is a noun, so the description 很清楚 takes 的. The same word before a verb would be 清楚地.

items.q: 老师说话说___很清楚，我们都听得懂。
items.zh: 老师说话说得很清楚，我们都听得懂。
items.py: lǎo shī shuō huà shuō de hěn qīng chǔ wǒ men dōu tīng de dǒng
items.en: The teacher speaks very clearly and we all understand.
items.why: 说话说 + 得 + 很清楚 judges how the teacher speaks. 地 would go in front of a verb, but 很清楚 follows the verb.

items.q: 我累___不想走路了。
items.zh: 我累得不想走路了。
items.py: wǒ lèi de bù xiǎng zǒu lù le
items.en: I'm so tired I don't want to walk any more.
items.why: 累 is a state and 不想走路了 is the result of it, so 得 links them. 地 would turn 累 into a manner of walking, which is not the meaning.

items.q: 附近新开了一家非常热闹___咖啡馆，周末常常坐满了人。
items.zh: 附近新开了一家非常热闹的咖啡馆，周末常常坐满了人。
items.py: fù jìn xīn kāi le yī jiā fēi cháng rè nào de kā fēi guǎn zhōu mò cháng cháng zuò mǎn le rén
items.en: A very lively cafe has newly opened nearby, and on weekends it is often full of people.
items.why: 热闹 describes the noun 咖啡馆 right after the gap, so 的. 热闹得 would need a result clause, and 地 a verb, neither of which follows.

items.q: 我哥哥游泳___特别快。
items.zh: 我哥哥游泳游得特别快。
items.py: wǒ gē gē yóu yǒng yóu de tè bié kuài
items.en: My older brother swims especially fast.
items.why: 游泳 is verb + object, so only 游 is repeated: 游泳游得. 游泳得 attaches 得 to the object noun 泳.

items.q: 教练严肃___对我们说：“明天别迟到。”
items.zh: 教练严肃地对我们说：“明天别迟到。”
items.py: jiào liàn yán sù de duì wǒ men shuō míng tiān bié chí dào
items.en: The coach said to us seriously, "Do not be late tomorrow."
items.why: 严肃 is the manner of speaking and the verb 对我们说 follows, so 地. 严肃得 would need a result clause to follow.

items.q: 我喜欢这家很便宜___小饭馆。
items.zh: 我喜欢这家很便宜的小饭馆。
items.py: wǒ xǐ huān zhè jiā hěn pián yi de xiǎo fàn guǎn
items.en: I like this very cheap little restaurant.
items.why: The noun 小饭馆 follows the gap and 很便宜 describes it, so 的. 地 would introduce a verb, which is not here.

items.q: 那位年轻___教练对每个队员都很耐心。
items.zh: 那位年轻的教练对每个队员都很耐心。
items.py: nà wèi nián qīng de jiào liàn duì měi gè duì yuán dōu hěn nài xīn
items.en: That young coach is patient with every player.
items.why: 年轻 is a plain adjective in front of the noun 教练, so 的. The later verb phrase is a separate predicate and does not change the position of the gap.

items.q: 在公园跑步___人很多。
items.zh: 在公园跑步的人很多。
items.py: zài gōng yuán pǎo bù de rén hěn duō
items.en: There are many people jogging in the park.
items.why: 在公园跑步 describes who the 人 are, so the clause is linked to the noun with 的. 地 would put a verb after it.

items.q: 弟弟跳___不太高。
items.zh: 弟弟跳得不太高。
items.py: dì di tiào de bù tài gāo
items.en: My younger brother doesn't jump very high.
items.why: The verb 跳 is followed by a judgement 不太高, so 得. The 不 belongs on the judgement, never in front of the verb.

items.q: 她有一双大大___眼睛，很喜欢打羽毛球。
items.zh: 她有一双大大的眼睛，很喜欢打羽毛球。
items.py: tā yǒu yī shuāng dà dà de yǎn jīng hěn xǐ huān dǎ yǔ máo qiú
items.en: She has a pair of big eyes and likes playing badminton.
items.why: 大大 describes the noun 眼睛, so the doubled adjective takes 的. Doubling does not force 地.

items.q: 请你仔细___听路线。
items.zh: 请你仔细地听路线。
items.py: qǐng nǐ zǐ xì de tīng lù xiàn
items.en: Please listen carefully to the route.
items.why: 仔细 tells how to 听, so 仔细 + 地 + verb. 得 would require a verb or adjective before it with a judgement after.

items.s: 他是一个跑得很快的运动员。
items.s_py: tā shì yí gè pǎo de hěn kuài de yùn dòng yuán
items.zh: 他是一个跑得很快的运动员。
items.py: tā shì yī gè pǎo de hěn kuài de yùn dòng yuán
items.en: He is an athlete who runs very fast.
items.why: 跑得很快 is the clause, and 的 joins it to the noun 运动员. Both de are correct.

items.q: 你刚才问___那家银行就在前面。
items.zh: 你刚才问的那家银行就在前面。
items.py: nǐ gāng cái wèn de nà jiā yín háng jiù zài qián miàn
items.en: The bank you just asked about is right ahead.
items.why: 你刚才问 is a clause that identifies the noun 那家银行, so 的 joins them. A verb after the gap would be needed for 地.

items.q: 他骑自行车___不太稳。
items.zh: 他骑自行车骑得不太稳。
items.py: tā qí zì xíng chē qí de bù tài wěn
items.en: He doesn't ride a bike very steadily.
items.why: With the object 自行车 after 骑, the verb must come back before 得: 骑自行车骑得不太稳. 得 alone would follow the object.

items.q: 他饿___连跑步的力气都没有了。
items.zh: 他饿得连跑步的力气都没有了。
items.py: tā è de lián pǎo bù de lì qì dōu méi yǒu le
items.en: He was so hungry he did not even have the strength to run.
items.why: 饿 is a state, and 连跑步的力气都没有了 is how far it went, so 得. 饿 cannot be the manner of any action here, so 地 fails.

items.q: 这是我朋友___手机。
items.zh: 这是我朋友的手机。
items.en: This is my friend's phone.
items.why: 手机 is a noun and 朋友 is its owner, so 的 joins them. 得 needs a verb or adjective before it, and 地 needs a verb after it.
items.py: zhè shì wǒ péng yǒu de shǒu jī

items.q: 我想买一个很大___手机。
items.zh: 我想买一个很大的手机。
items.en: I want to buy a very big phone.
items.why: 很大 describes the noun 手机, so 的. 地 would need a verb next, and 得 needs a verb or adjective in front of it plus a judgement after.
items.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī gè hěn dà de shǒu jī

items.q: 昨天我在网上看了一个很有意思___视频。
items.zh: 昨天我在网上看了一个很有意思的视频。
items.en: Yesterday I watched a very interesting video online.
items.why: 视频 is a noun, so the description 很有意思 links to it with 的. 地 would need a verb next, and 得 would need a verb right before it.
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ zài wǎng shàng kàn le yī gè hěn yǒu yì sī de shì pín

items.q: 这是一个非常方便___聊天软件。
items.zh: 这是一个非常方便的聊天软件。
items.en: This is a very convenient chat app.
items.why: 聊天软件 is a noun described by 非常方便, so 的. 地 only fits in front of a verb.
items.py: zhè shì yī gè fēi cháng fāng biàn de liáo tiān ruǎn jiàn

items.q: 我想买一个又轻又好用___耳机，出门带着也不重。
items.zh: 我想买一个又轻又好用的耳机，出门带着也不重。
items.en: I want to buy a headset that is both light and easy to use, so it isn't heavy to carry around.
